description:

* 12+ years of experience in software design and architecture.

* Strong knowledge of developing/designing imaging applications.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and protocols such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
* Good understanding of medical quality standards, including ISO 13485.

title: Director - DWE Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Director, DWE Platform Architect owns the architecture of the Digital Workplace Experience domain, setting the target architecture, reference designs and standards across End User Computing and Mobile Device Management, Productivity & Collaboration and Global Site Experience. The role leads the architecture team, owns design assurance for the domain, and ensures the domain is coherent, secure, resilient and aligned to enterprise architecture.

The role leads architects rather than producing every design. Individual platform designs sit with the Platform Architects in the team, engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, platform roadmaps sit with the Senior Product Owners, and enterprise-level standards and technology strategy sit with the Chief Architect. This role sets the domain direction and holds designs to it, including those produced by delivery partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the domain target architecture, standards and reference designs, aligned to DPTF strategy and to the enterprise architecture and technology strategy owned by the Chief Architect.
* Lead the architecture team across the domain, managing performance, capability development and the technical direction they work to.
* Own the design assurance process for the domain, setting what must be reviewed, by whom and against which standards, and holding that standard against delivery pressure.
* Embed AI patterns into the domain architecture, so that AI-assisted delivery and intelligent, self-healing operation of workplace services are designed in.
* Architect for reliability, resilience, observability and cost efficiency by design, supporting the service levels the domain commits to and designing out single points of failure.
* Ensure security, data protection and compliance, including GxP where relevant, are designed into the domain and not retrofitted.
* Guide technology selection and modernisation across the domain, maintaining the architectural view of the estate including technical debt and lifecycle position, and measuring outcomes against architecture objectives.
* Set the architecture standards that supplier and managed service solutions in the domain must meet, and assure partner-delivered designs against them.
* Align the domain to enterprise architecture and technology strategy, negotiating exceptions where the domain genuinely requires them.
* Advise the Head of Digital Workplace Experience on architectural risk, technical debt and the investment needed to address both.
* Maintain architecture decision records for the domain, increasing pattern reuse and reducing rework, and evidencing both with measures.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architects on individual platform designs, the platform engineering teams on delivery, the Senior Product Owners on platform roadmaps, and the Chief Architect on enterprise standards.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or a recognised cloud or workplace platform architecture certification relevant to the domain).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Domain architecture leadership, covering target architecture, standards, reference designs and design assurance governance.
* Digital workplace architecture across end user computing, mobility, productivity and collaboration, and site technology.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 18 Years and typically 10-12 years in technology architecture, including at least three years leading an architecture team with line responsibility.
* Experience owning a target architecture at domain or equivalent scale, not solely at solution level.
* Track record running design assurance governance, including holding a standard against delivery pressure.
* Deep experience of digital workplace technologies across end user computing, mobile device management, and productivity and collaboration platforms.
* Experience designing for reliability, resilience, observability and security in a regulated environment.
* Experience setting and assuring architecture standards for supplier and managed service delivered solutions.
* Familiarity with AI patterns applied to workplace services and to intelligent operations.

**Desirable:**

  

* Deep knowledge of Digital Workplace & Experience platforms, Microsoft 365, End User Computing, Device Management, Collaboration, AI-powered workplace services, Global Site Experience Modern Architecture

  

* Practical understanding of Digital Workplace & Experience AI architecture patterns AI-assisted delivery, intelligent operations, automation, and emerging AI platform capabilities.

* Digital Workplace & Experience supplier and managed service architecture governance, experience setting standards and evaluating vendor-provided solutions.

  

* Commercial and financial acumen, ability to articulate Digital Workplace & Experience technical debt, architectural risk, investment priorities, and business value to executive

**Skills/Background**

* Deep technical breadth across workplace technologies, with the judgement to know where standardisation matters and where it does not.
* Strong design assurance discipline, able to challenge a solution constructively without becoming a bottleneck.
* Excellent communication, able to explain architectural trade-offs to audiences without a technical background.
* Ability to lead and develop a team of architects.
* Ability to influence engineering teams and suppliers who do not report to the role.
* Commercial awareness, able to weigh architectural preference against cost and lifecycle risk.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, Architecture Governance, Cloud Computing, Container Orchestration, Data Center Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), Mobile Device Management (MDM), Network Design, Serverless Platforms, Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), Storage Area Network (SAN), Strategic Leadership, System Monitors, Technical Architecture, Technical Architecture Design, Virtualization, Workplace Architecture, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: SAP Architect
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role**

The SAP Architect is Refold’s resident SAP expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise SAP problems. You’ve spent years working with SAP ecosystems, understand SAP architecture and enterprise processes inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of SAP systems, data models, APIs, and how SAP connects with the broader enterprise technology landscape. You set the technical approach where there’s no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts on SAP architecture and implementations.

* **Team:** Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning SAP architecture and enterprise implementations.
* **Building**: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations involving complex SAP environments at enterprise scale — the problems for which no playbook exists yet.
* **You’ll work with:** CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architecture teams at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the architecture for the hardest SAP problems. Design complex, mission-critical solutions involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, and other enterprise systems, addressing complex business processes, data flows, and cross-system dependencies, especially where no playbook exists yet.
* Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior SAP technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important SAP architecture and implementation initiatives.
* Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on SAP system architecture, data modelling, integration patterns, extensibility, agentic orchestration, authentication, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load.
* Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers’ security and compliance teams on SAP security models, role-based access controls, SSO, VPC, mTLS, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture.
* Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across SAP implementations, customer accounts, and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap.
* Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into SAP reference architectures, implementation patterns, solution blueprints, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base.
* Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the SAP technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews, solution design discussions, and technical deep dives.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6–10 years of experience in SAP architecture, SAP technical consulting, or enterprise solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in designing and delivering complex SAP solutions.
* Mandatory hands-on SAP experience with enterprise SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, and a strong understanding of SAP architecture, implementation approaches, and enterprise business processes.
* Excellent, deep understanding of SAP integration capabilities and technologies, including SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP APIs, OData, IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and relevant integration patterns.
* A deep technical problem-solver who designs solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer.
* Deep expertise in SAP solution architecture, SAP data models, enterprise application landscapes, and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architects.
* Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration).
* Prior principal/staff SAP architect, lead SAP technical consultant, enterprise solutions architect, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup.
* Direct experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, SAP Fiori, SAP ABAP, and SAP business processes across finance, procurement, supply chain, or other enterprise functions.
* Experience with SAP integration and middleware technologies, including SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite, alongside platforms such as Workato, Boomi, or MuleSoft.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Refold**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the technical win:** Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* **Build the proof, don't slide it:** Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* **Run crisp POCs:** Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* **Speak both languages:** Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* **Clear security and procurement:** Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* **Hand off clean:** Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* **Feed the platform:** You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* **Build the SE motion:** Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information:**

* **Partners with:** The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months
* **Technical buyers you'll face:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* **Ideal customer:** Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Competitive set:** iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* **Proven SE:** 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* **Builder, not just a presenter:** Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* **Enterprise systems fluency:** Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* **Sales instinct:** You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* **Room-ready:** You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* **High ownership in ambiguity:** No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

**Nice to Have**

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

title: Software Stability Expert / System Health, Stability
description:
Required Experience, minimum: 3 years

  

Required Experience, maximum: 8 years

  

* Skills: Infotainment - Automotive

  

* Minimum Qualification: B.Tech/B.E

  

**Software Stability Expert / CoC System Health, Stability**
============================================================

**Unit and team Overview**
--------------------------

Infotainment platforms unit is responsible for developing, maintaining and deploying BMW infotainment platform. BMW infotainment platform is Linux (Yocto) based SW platform that provides common automotive functions used by multiple automotive ECUs. The unit is also responsible for cross-cutting concerns of the platform, like architecture, security, stability and performance. The platform is deployed into multiple infotainment domain ECUs, ranging from headunits and rear seat entertainment systems to telematics and audio ECUs.

### **Stability**

The Center of Competence (CoC) 'System Health, Stability' is responsible for monitoring and analyzing stability problems (e.g., system resets, application crashes) for multiple infotainment projects. We automatically scan and pre-filter all logs from test drives to detect stability problems early during development. Supported by a defect front desk, we process more than 1000 stability tickets per month. In conjunction with the development teams, the team expediates solutions to these problems and supports in root cause analysis. As the stability problems need to be solved by the individual teams, a close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders is essential.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As part of the Stability and System Engineering team, you will help ensure the reliability and performance of next-generation Linux- and Android-based automotive control units. A key focus of your role will be defect management: analyzing issues reported during integration, validation, and vehicle drive testing; identifying root causes; and coordinating effective fixes across teams.

You will work closely with architects, software developers, integration teams, test engineers, and management to assess the impact and priority of defects, provide timely status updates, and improve the stability of software deliveries.

* Manage stability-related defects throughout the software delivery lifecycle, from issue intake and triage through root-cause analysis, resolution, and verification.
* Perform first-hand analysis of high-priority defects, establish their impact and reproducibility, and drive timely investigation with the responsible teams.
* Investigate complex issues involving system stability, performance, boot sequence, memory management, CPU utilization, resource usage, and system services.
* Analyze defects across the Linux kernel, Android framework, HAL, middleware, drivers, and applications.
* Conduct root-cause analysis using debugging, tracing, profiling, and system-analysis tools.
* Analyze crash dumps, kernel panics, ANRs, tombstones, watchdog resets, memory leaks, and other stability-related evidence.
* Review drive-test findings and provide a daily summary of results, including key defects, severity, trends, open risks, and progress, for management and relevant stakeholders.
* Track defect status, ownership, dependencies, and resolution progress, and communicate risks and blockers clearly.
* Create automation scripts and engineering tools for stability analysis, log collection, debugging, and performance monitoring.
* Collaborate with management, architecture, development, integration, validation, and customer teams to resolve critical platform issues.
* Identify recurring defect patterns and drive continuous improvements in platform reliability, performance, and software quality through data-driven analysis.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required Experience and Skills**

* A university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a similar field.

title: Associate Director - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 8-10 years in cloud and SAP infrastructure, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems.
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

  

* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Development, Reliability Engineering, SAP Infrastructure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Principal Process Pulse Engineer role provides technical leadership for the Aspen Tech Process Pulse platform and related PAT systems across GSK Global Supply Chain and R&D sites. The role owns solution design, OT(Operational Technology) architecture alignment, implementation, validation and troubleshooting for Process Pulse deployments and ensures that technical outputs align with approved OT Reference Architectures, Quality & Tech Management controls/ standards, product strategy and engineering standards. The job holder leads Process Pulse solution configurations (data sources, models, configurations, triggers, (OPC Unified Architecture) OPC UA interfaces, firewall data flows), coordinates engineers, site OT/Automation teams, Architects, Product Owners, OT Security and suppliers, and acts as the technical lead for complex delivery and operational issues in OT environments. They review technical specifications, configurations and validation evidence, lead root-cause analysis where operational, batch or data-integrity impact may exist, and develop engineering capability by coaching engineers and super users and converting lessons learned into reusable designs, standards, training and knowledge.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Implement Process Pulse technical designs and configurations (servers, database, data collectors, dashboards) in line with approved OT architecture, segmentation and product strategy
* Own technical quality for Process Pulse across assigned sites, including key specifications, design documentation, configuration records and validation evidence
* Manage the lifecycle of PAT models (creation, validation, deployment, monitoring and retirement) across platforms such as Process Pulse and Unscrambler, ensuring models are version-controlled, traceable and fit for process and quality use.

**Job Purpose**

The Director, Digital Platforms & Integration is accountable for defining, delivering and continuously evolving the foundational digital platforms, integration capabilities and information frameworks that enable GSK's future smart manufacturing, supply chain and CMC digital ecosystem.

The role leads the strategy, execution and operational performance of the Factory Integration Layer (FIL) as a critical enterprise capability connecting manufacturing systems, laboratory platforms, engineering applications, cloud services and business processes. The position ensures that platform and integration investments create reusable, scalable and technology-agnostic capabilities that accelerate business outcomes across sites, functions and products.

The Director is accountable for the Azure Local migration strategy, establishing a modern, secure and resilient hybrid foundation for digital products, analytics, AI and industrial data solutions across the manufacturing network.

As a key leader within the CMC Acceleration Program, the role owns delivery and integration of enterprise ontologies, knowledge-management capabilities, data pipelines and information architectures that transform fragmented data into connected, contextualized and actionable knowledge. The position enables digital thread capabilities across development, technology transfer, manufacturing, quality and supply chain operations.

Working with Product Leaders, Business Process Owners, Architects, Data & AI teams, Manufacturing Technology leaders and strategic partners, the Director aligns multiple transformation initiatives while ensuring solutions remain scalable, compliant, supportable and aligned to enterprise standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for the Factory Integration Layer, creating a scalable digital backbone connecting manufacturing, laboratory, quality, engineering, data and enterprise platforms.
* Establish FIL as a reusable enterprise capability through standard integration patterns, event-driven services, APIs, information models and repeatable site-onboarding approaches.
* Lead Azure Local migration across relevant manufacturing and operational workloads, ensuring secure cutover, continuity, validation, resilience and sustainable product and service ownership.
* Own Digital Platforms & Integration deliverables for the CMC Acceleration Program, translating development, technology-transfer and manufacturing priorities into integrated platform outcomes.
* Lead the creation and operational adoption of enterprise ontologies, semantic models and common information definitions that connect product, process, material, equipment, recipe and manufacturing knowledge.
* Lead the team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and ensuring compliance with GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Integrate knowledge-management capabilities across scientific, development and manufacturing domains to improve information discoverability, reuse, traceability and knowledge continuity.
* Define platform governance, architecture guardrails, decision rights and performance measures covering adoption, reliability, throughput, latency, data quality, service effort, security and value realization.
* Scan emerging platform, integration and edge capability (vendor roadmaps, new releases), pilot the most promising and bring a ranked opportunity list into the investment forums.
* Own material delivery and operational risks, ensuring appropriate governance for cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, regulatory compliance and business continuity.
* Sponsor operational readiness for major releases and migrations, integrating support models, training, documentation, deployment, monitoring, service transition and user adoption.
* Shape strategic supplier contributions and resolve delivery, quality, commercial or capability issues affecting multiple platforms, products, sites or programs.
* Represent digital platforms, integration health, dependencies, risks and investment impacts in senior product, architecture, data, cyber and transformation governance forums.
* Build a high-performing, inclusive community of platform, integration and data professionals, strengthening engineering excellence, product ownership and continuous improvement.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Professional qualifications in cloud, enterprise architecture, integration, data management, product management, agile delivery, service management or cyber security are desirable.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology, digital manufacturing, integration platforms, cloud technologies, data platforms or digital transformation, including leadership of complex or regulated capabilities.
* Proven accountability for enterprise-scale platform strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management with material business, operational and risk impact.
* Experience leading Factory Integration Layer, industrial integration, OT/IT convergence, edge computing or comparable manufacturing-platform capabilities.
* Experience leading Azure Local, hybrid-cloud or edge-infrastructure migration, including architecture, security, validation, cutover, operational readiness and service transition.
* Demonstrated delivery of ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, knowledge-management integrations, data pipelines or digital-thread capabilities.
* Experience leading multiple Product Owners, Architects, Engineers, Data specialists or delivery workstreams and establishing clear decision rights and technical guardrails.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve strategic trade-offs across value, cost, capacity, architecture, data, cyber security, compliance and business continuity.
* Experience influencing Director and VP stakeholders and representing platform delivery in investment, architecture, data, risk and transformation forums.
* Strong experience managing cross-platform dependencies, supplier contributions, complex migrations and global release sequencing.
* Experience strengthening ways of working, coaching technical talent and building sustainable platform, integration and knowledge-management capabilities.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Enterprise architecture and systems thinking, with the ability to connect business capability, information, integration, infrastructure and service views.
* Executive communication and confidence operating in senior governance forums.
* Deep understanding of integration patterns, APIs, event streaming, industrial connectivity and contextualized data flows.
* Working knowledge of Azure Local, hybrid infrastructure, edge computing, containers and platform engineering practices.
* Knowledge of ontologies, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, metadata and knowledge-management principles.
* Analytical judgement to balance value, risk, cost, complexity, urgency and operational impact.
* Strong organisation, traceability, documentation and decision-management discipline.
* Ability to lead global, cross-functional and supplier teams through ambiguity and complex dependencies.
* Commitment to user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.
* Passion for engineering excellence, responsible AI enablement, smart manufacturing and continuous improvement.

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
**Join the Future of Security at Netskope**
-------------------------------------------

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

### **About the team**

We are seeking an exceptional Engineer to build next-generation security analytics and AI-powered capabilities within Netskope's platform. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who excels at solving complex technical problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, large-scale data systems, and cybersecurity.

As a Sr.Staff Engineer, you will own the architecture and delivery of cloud services that handle large volumes of data and traffic for enterprise customers. You'll set technical direction, raise the engineering bar for the team, and ship.

### **What's in it for you**

This is your chance to work at the absolute intersection of Artificial Intelligence, large-scale Data Systems, and Cybersecurity. You won't just use existing tools; you will be designing and implementing sophisticated, cutting-edge systems that fundamentally change how enterprises detect and respond to threats.

### **What you will be doing**

* Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance backend services in Python on AWS
* Architect distributed systems with sound tradeoffs across consistency, availability, latency, cost, and operational complexity
* Provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from discovery and design through delivery and operations
* Use AI-native development workflows (Claude Code) to accelerate design, implementation, testing, code review, and debugging, and help the team develop effective practices for doing so
* Partner with product and customers to turn requirements into well-scoped, well-designed features
* Investigate and resolve production issues, and drive improvements to observability, reliability, and incident response
* Improve engineering processes, CI/CD, and developer tooling

### **Required skills and experience**

* 12+ years of software development experience, including building enterprise-grade backend systems
* Expert-level Python, with strong experience building production backend services and REST APIs
* Deep experience with AWS and cloud architecture (e.g., compute, storage, networking, messaging, IAM, managed data services)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals: scalability, fault tolerance, concurrency, data consistency, and event-driven or asynchronous architectures
* Solid knowledge of databases and data stores, both relational and NoSQL (OLTP and OLAP)
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* **Demonstrated fluency with AI-native development**, including daily, hands-on use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools. You can describe how you decompose work for an AI agent, review and validate its output critically, and maintain quality, security, and maintainability while moving faster.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where you might lead a design one week and fix a critical bug or improve CI the next

### **Nice to have**

* **Hands-on experience building production LLM agents, including orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, ReAct-style reasoning and tool-use loops, and deep agent patterns (planning, sub-agents, long-running tasks)**
* Experience with observability tooling and SLO-driven operations
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation)
* Experience with streaming and messaging systems (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS)

### **Education**

* BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

Troubleshooting skills are essential as this role will include working with Microsoft Support to expedite incident resolution.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

\* Provide architectural reviews and technical guidance to \*\*Support for Mission Critical (SfMC) customers\*\*, focusing on the reliability, security, and performance.  
\* Take \*\*end-to-end ownership and accountability\*\* of technical deliverables, ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes and Microsoft’s best practices.  

* Identify architectural risks, design gaps, and operational inefficiencies across services.

\* Engage with SfMC stakeholders to drive architectural validation, incident prevention, and workload health improvements through \*\*proactive engagements\*\* and \*\*deep technical assessments\*\*.  

* Collaborate closely with Microsoft engineering and support teams to address escalations, share feedback, and align solutions with platform evolution.

\* Drive creation and reusability of IP including \*\*scripts, tools, and technical documentation\*\* to support scalable SfMC engagements.  
\* Act as a \*\*trusted advisor\*\* to customer architects and engineers, influencing long-term technical strategy for stability, resilience, and innovation.

Required Qualifications:  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience

Additional Preferred Qualifications:  
• 10+ years of experience in cloud data platforms, with a strong focus on Azure. • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, and Azure AI services (including Cognitive Services and OpenAI) in secure environments, including data warehousing, ETL pipelines, and real-time data processing. • Proven expertise in data engineering, data science workflows, and ML model deployment using Azure tools. • Experience designing and implementing end-to-end AI/ML solutions in enterprise environments. • Strong understanding of distributed computing, big data processing, and data lake architectures. • Familiarity with Cosmos DB and SQL Server will be helpful. • Experience with Azure architecture, including IaaS, PaaS, and serverless components. • Ability to use debugging tools, trace analysis, and source code to troubleshoot and optimize performance. • Solid understanding of networking, security, and resilience in cloud-native applications. • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams. • Excellent communication skills in international environments – both spoken and written English. • Effective learning and presentation skills, with comfort in addressing both small and large audiences. • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

In this role, your impact will be immense. Whether it's crafting comprehensive use cases, tracing requirements meticulously, or visualizing process flows, your attention to detail will be unmatched.

As the driving force behind our customers' application modernization endeavors, you'll guide them through every step of the process, ensuring their systems are future-proofed and optimized for success. In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.

You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in application development and deployment
* 5+ years in application migration and modernization
* 5+ years in application architecture, middleware and data experience
* Variety of technologies including BI, database principles, programming fundamentals, SQL, hardware/software, operating systems and networking
* Strong technical acumen & deep working knowledge of Agile Methods, Service Architecture, and enterprise Cloud Integration
* Strong ability to influence, collaborate and build relationships with key stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams

* Application modernization tools, e.g. CAST

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer**

***Position Overview***

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with at least 7 years of experience in full-stack software development, web crawling, network protocol analysis, and enterprise data telemetry. In this role, you will bridge the gap between application architecture, web scraper engineering, network traffic analysis, and data analytics.

Using Node.js as your primary backend environment, you will design automated crawling engines, analyze client-side rendering mechanics, monitor live application traffic in New Relic, and join web-level findings with data warehouse records to produce high-impact analytical reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Full-Stack Engineering & Web Crawling

Full-Stack Development: Architect, develop, and maintain robust services and analytics applications using Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript) on the backend along with modern frontend frameworks.

Scalable Web Crawling: Design and scale high-throughput crawling suites using Node.js automation libraries (Playwright, Puppeteer) to inspect complex DOM structures, handle dynamic client-side rendering, and extract structured metadata.

DOM & Rendering Analysis: Evaluate the browser rendering lifecycle—including HTML/CSS parsing, JavaScript execution, DOM tree construction, layout, and visual paint—to detect client-side performance bottlenecks or script execution failures.

**2. HTTP Protocol & Network Traffic Analysis**

Network & Payload Inspection: Perform deep-dive analysis on inbound and outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic, inspecting request/response headers, status codes, cookies, session tokens, payloads, and API endpoints.

APM & Traffic Patterns: Monitor real-time traffic volumes, request distribution, latency metrics, and error rates using New Relic (or equivalent APM systems) to detect operational anomalies and traffic spikes.

Full-Trace Mapping: Correlate client-side event triggers and tracking calls with server logs, microservice calls, and backend API responses.

**3. Data Warehouse Integration & Reporting**

Data Warehouse Querying: Write complex, optimized SQL queries and manage data pipelines to extract and aggregate large-scale records from platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

**Data Synthesis:** Merge web crawling datasets, HTTP payload logs, and APM telemetry with warehouse transaction history to perform root-cause analysis and pattern identification.

Technical Reporting: Build and deliver comprehensive technical reports, automated executive dashboards, and actionable recommendations for product, platform, and data teams.

**Required Qualifications**

Professional Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering, with a strong focus on backend systems, web scraping, and data-driven web analytics.

Node.js Expertise: 7+ years of deep technical proficiency in Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript), microservices architecture, and asynchronous runtime performance tuning.

Frontend Mechanics: Master-level understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript runtime engines, browser rendering paths, DOM structures, and DevTools.

Browser Automation: Demonstrated track record building resilient, production-grade scrapers using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium within a Node.js ecosystem.

Networking & Protocols: Expert knowledge of network protocols (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTPS), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, CORS, cookies, and HTTP request/response lifecycle mechanics.

Telemetry & APM: Hands-on expertise with New Relic or similar enterprise monitoring suites to analyze system performance, network payloads, and user traffic behavior.

**Preferred Qualifications**

5+ years in a senior or lead technical capacity guiding web architecture, data engineering pipelines, or scraping infrastructure.

Data Warehouse & SQL: Advanced SQL skills and extensive experience extracting, transforming, and loading data across cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

Familiarity with bypassing advanced anti-bot protections, IP rotation systems, and browser fingerprinting challenges.

Practical experience deploying serverless microservices (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers) for distributed web crawling tasks.

description:

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

  
  

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  
  

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.
  

  

Even Better If...

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We collaborate with education organizations to develop strategies and implement solutions that enable the transformative change our clients need to own their future. Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes.  
  
Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change.  
  
You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability.  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Huron is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to join its product engineering team. You will own the test automation strategy and framework architecture, ensuring reliability and accuracy across complex application workflows. Embedded in Agile delivery teams alongside developers, product managers, and designers, you bring a software engineering mindset to quality problems and set the quality bar the whole team works toward.

**Primary responsibilities**

**Test strategy and technical leadership**

* Define and own the test strategy, framework architecture, and tooling roadmap for assigned product areas.
* Translate business requirements into traceable test cases across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end dimensions; lead test plan reviews with developers, product owners, and project managers.
* Define test coverage metrics and quality gates; produce risk-based release readiness reports for engineering leadership at each milestone.

**Test automation and AI-assisted engineering**

* **AI-assisted development:** Leverage GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and comparable AI coding assistants to accelerate test script authorship, generate edge-case scenarios, and perform intelligent code review.
* **AI agentic testing:** Configure and evaluate agentic workflows for autonomous test generation and self-healing locators; apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents to test tools, APIs, and data sources for end-to-end agentic test workflows; define system instructions, skills, and tool configurations for AI coding agents.
* Architect and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI; REST Assured or similar for APIs; integrate into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

The Senior Technical SME for QA Systems provides technical leadership across the Quality Assurance product family and technology platforms, including Veeva, SAP, Mendix and AI-enabled automation solutions. The role leads solution design, implementation, validation and troubleshooting, ensuring technical outputs align with approved architecture, product strategy and engineering standards. The job holder reviews technical specifications, configurations and test evidence, and leads root-cause analysis were operational, batch or data-integrity impact may exist. * Design, develop, test and implement AI-enabled automation and agents capabilities supporting the Quality Assurance platform development team, implementing technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy.

* Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence, and assess technical risks to ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability.

* Ensure appropriate controls for responsible artificial intelligence, data privacy, cybersecurity, human oversight, traceability and regulated change, and lead complex investigations into artificial intelligence quality, retrieval, data, integration and operational issues.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences or another technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with technical, cloud, integration, automation, data, validation, cyber security or engineering certifications.
* Minimum of five years of hands-on technical engineering experience in large-scale enterprise or operational technology environments.
* Experience leading technical design and implementation for a product family, platform, programme or multiple sites, and reviewing and approving specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and technical validation evidence.
* Experience leading troubleshooting and root-cause investigations across systems, interfaces, workflows, data and infrastructure, and coordinating internal engineers, site teams, vendors and specialist partners through design, deployment and stabilization activities.
* Experience assessing technical risk and ensuring security, data integrity, resilience, compliance and supportability requirements are met.
* Experience coaching engineers and converting lessons learned into reusable standards, patterns and knowledge assets.
* Experience leading at least one artificial intelligence or generative artificial intelligence solution from design through testing, controlled release and operational support.
* Experience supporting audits, inspections and formal technical assurance activities, and designing or providing technical assurance for intelligent automation solutions.
* Experience defining artificial intelligence evaluation datasets, measurable acceptance criteria and risk-based test strategies, and integrating artificial intelligence services with enterprise applications, data sources and workflow platforms.
* Experience providing technical directions to engineers, suppliers and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Apply analytical and structured problem-solving methods to technical engineering and automation activities l and structured problem-solving skills applied to technical engineering and automation activities.
* Experience in Translating architecture and product direction into technical designs and implementation plans.
* Experience in Producing technical documentation and maintaining specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records in line with governance requirements.
* Experience in interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support practices.
* Experience in security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change control requirements.
* Collaborates across global business, site, engineering, architecture, product, service and supplier teams, contributing to continuous improvement activities with focus on standardization, reuse, automation and knowledge sharing.
* Provides technical leadership by reviewing designs against requirements and standards, proposing improvements, and providing coaching and structured knowledge transfer within engineering and operations teams.
* Communicates technical risk and recommendations to governance forums and senior stakeholders using inclusive and accessible language, drawing on applied knowledge of generative artificial intelligence, large language models, machine learning and retrieval-augmented generation.

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

title: Application Platform Architect
description:
As an Application Platform Architect at Zeta Global, you will be a visionary leader responsible for designing the foundational architecture that supports all of our applications and services. You will focus on building a scalable, reliable, and secure platform that empowers engineering teams to build and deploy applications with speed and efficiency. This role involves defining standards, selecting technologies, and guiding the development of core platform components such as microservices frameworks, APIs, and shared libraries—including those that enable AI agents and agentic workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform Strategy:** Define the technical vision and roadmap for the Zeta application platform, ensuring it meets the long-term needs of the business and engineering teams.
* **Architectural Design:** Design and lead the implementation of core platform services, including reusable microservices, APIs, and shared components that serve all applications.
* **AI Platform Integration:** Architect and build the underlying platform services and APIs that enable the seamless integration of **AI agents, large language models (LLMs)**, and **agentic workflows**. Design a robust and scalable infrastructure to support these advanced capabilities.
* **Scalability & Reliability:** Ensure the platform's architecture can handle increasing scale and complexity, with a focus on high availability, performance, and fault tolerance.
* **Developer Enablement:** Create tools, frameworks, and best practices that improve the developer experience, accelerate development velocity, and ensure consistency across all applications.
* **Technology Evaluation:** Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and architectural patterns to keep the platform at the forefront of innovation.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to embed security, monitoring, and operational best practices into the platform's design and development lifecycle.
* **Documentation & Governance:** Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, guidelines, and governance standards for the platform's architecture and usage.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a lead architect or principal engineer role.
* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale, distributed application platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as **Java, Scala, or Python**.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (**AWS** preferred) and cloud-native services.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (**Docker, Kubernetes**).
* Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (**Terraform, Ansible**).
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML frameworks like **LangChain**, LlamaIndex, or similar, and a proven track record of architecting platforms to support them.
* Experience with service meshes (**Istio, Linkerd**) and API gateways.
* Familiarity with identity and access management (**IAM**) systems.
* Experience with security architecture, including threat modeling and secure-by-design principles.
* A track record of contributing to open-source projects or speaking at industry conferences.

  

**Company Profile:**

Zeta Global is a data-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi-Cola, the Company combines the industry's 3rd largest proprietary data set (2.4B+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

Zeta Global is a leading AI-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes.

Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by Zeta™, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer's workspace, surfaces platform generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes.

Learn more about Zeta: https://zetaglobal.com/press-news/

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's network segmentation and security platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them.
