title: AI Systems Architecture Engineer – Lead Senior Engineer/Senior Engineer
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

**General Summary:**

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation intelligent computing, AI, connectivity, and low-power embedded technologies.

We are seeking an experienced AI Systems Architect to define, prototype, and optimize next-generation AI computing systems across heterogeneous hardware and software platforms. This role will focus on understanding how AI workloads utilize system resources and developing architectural solutions that maximize performance, power efficiency, scalability, and overall platform utilization.

The ideal candidate will work across hardware, firmware, runtime, compiler, and application layers to evaluate system-level tradeoffs and prototype innovative architectures for AI workloads. The role requires strong expertise in AI workloads, heterogeneous computing, system performance analysis, and architectural modeling.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Define and evaluate system architectures for AI platforms incorporating heterogeneous compute elements such as CPU, NPU, GPU, Memory interconnects and subsystems.
* Experience with profiling/modeling tools to understand optimal use of resources for getting best system performance
* Develop system-architecture prototypes to evaluate - workload partitioning across compute engines, data movement and memory traffic, compute and memory bottlenecks, scheduling and resource allocation, power, thermal, and performance tradeoffs
* Analyze AI workloads to determine the best utilization of available architectural resources across available compute and memory resources
* Investigate end-to-end AI execution pipelines, including -Model compilation and graph partitioning, Runtime scheduling, Kernel selection, Memory allocation, Data transfers, Synchronization, Accelerator utilization

* Build analytical models, simulators, emulators, and proof-of-concept implementations for assessing architectural concepts before hardware availability.

* Evaluate the impact of system-level parameters such as Compute throughput, Memory bandwidth, Cache and local memory capacity, Interconnect bandwidth and latency, DMA and data-transfer efficiency, Accelerator occupancy

* Identify performance bottlenecks and recommend architectural improvements based on workload characterization, profiling data, and benchmark results.

* Collaborate with hardware architects, AI accelerator designers, compiler teams, runtime engineers, firmware developers, performance engineers, and product teams.
* Define workload-driven architectural requirements and translate them into platform-level specifications.
* Develop technical proposals, architecture studies, tradeoff analyses, and performance projections for future AI platforms.
  

  

**Skills and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

* Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
  + AI or machine-learning systems
  + Computer architecture
  + Heterogeneous computing
  + SoC architecture
  + Accelerator architecture
  + High-performance computing
  + Embedded systems
  + System performance analysis
* 3-7 years of experience in hardware focused system optimization role (hiring across multiple levels).
* Strong understanding of computer architecture concepts

* Ability to develop quantitative models and make architecture recommendations based on empirical data.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, think critically, and adapt in a fast-paced and rapidly evolving technology environment.
  

  

**Good to have**

* Experience with AI specific performance optimization would be preferred. Hands-on experience optimizing AI models for performance, power, and accuracy on hardware accelerators such as CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
* Experience using processor-specific optimization tools, libraries, and profiling technologies to improve AI performance on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs is a plus.
* Strong understanding of modern machine learning architectures, including CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and ensemble methods would be good to have.
* Proficiency with AI frameworks and tooling such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime, and MLIR would be good to have.
* Experience with transformer-based models such as BERT, GPT, T5, and Llama. Experience developing, optimizing, or deploying large language models (LLMs) or foundation models is a strong plus.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently.

The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms.

We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions.

Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems.
* Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery.
* Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load.
* Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery.
* Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes.
* Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices.
* Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements.
* Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms.
* Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers.
* Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies.
* Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms.

* Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation.
* Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services.
* Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit.
* Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems.
* Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior.
* Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

title: Senior Principal - RTE
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Release Train Engineer is a servant leader and delivery coach for the Agile Release Train delivering GSK's network and connectivity platforms, applying SAFe practices within GSK's Technology operating model to coordinate the flow of value across the teams building and running those platforms. Operating consistently with the BCG platform operating model, the role treats the platform as a product delivered by a durable, cross-functional team, and is accountable for facilitating Programme Increment planning, coordinating dependencies and risks across teams, and driving predictable, high quality delivery through Agile ceremonies, flow metrics and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilitate Programme Increment planning and Agile Release Train execution**

* Plan, prepare and facilitate PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt workshops and other Agile Release Train events for the platform's teams.
* Coordinate Scrum of Scrums, ART sync and cross-team ceremonies to maintain alignment on scope, sequencing and delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Build and maintain the ART's Programme Board, tracking major milestones, cross-team dependencies and feature delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Support Product Management and Product Owners in refining the Programme Backlog and preparing content for Planning Interval events.

**Manage dependencies, risks and impediments across the train**

* Identify, track and resolve cross-team and cross-platform dependencies and risks using ROAM (Resolved, Owned, Accepted, Mitigated).
* Escalate and remove impediments to flow that individual teams cannot resolve themselves, including supplier, platform or portfolio level blockers.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Solution Train Engineers and Platform Managers to sequence work across dependent platforms and domains.

**Drive flow, predictability and continuous improvement**

* Track and report flow metrics including velocity, programme predictability, cycle time and quality trends, and use them to drive improvement actions.
* Coach teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile and SAFe practices, building local capability rather than acting as a single point of control.
* Partner with Portfolio, Solution and Platform stakeholders to continuously improve the ART's ways of working, tooling and use of automation or AI-assisted delivery practices.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

**Business Stakeholders**

* Product teams and business technology groups whose network or platform capability delivery depends on a predictable, well coordinated Agile Release Train.
* Business service owners and key users where delivery sequencing, dependencies or timelines affect service quality or adoption.
* Business service owners and key users where engineering quality, resilience or change risk directly affects business outcomes.

**Tech Stakeholders**

* Product Owners, Scrum Masters/Team Coaches, Principal Engineers and Platform Managers for the teams on the train.
* Solution Train Engineers, other Release Train Engineers, Domain Portfolio Managers and Platform Architects across dependent platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Reliability Engineering and Operations Excellence where dependencies or risks touch their domains.
* Reliability Engineering, Operations Excellence, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Quality and Compliance teams.
* Modern Engineering, DevSecOps, Observability, Automation Acceleration Hub, Automation Acceleration team and Agile/Delivery governance teams.

**Other**

* Strategic partners, managed service providers, system integrators and specialist suppliers whose teams participate in or are coordinated by the Agile Release Train.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience delivering Agile technology programmes.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (or Advanced RTE) certification, or a recognised equivalent, is expected.
* Additional Agile certifications such as SAFe Program Consultant, Certified ScrumMaster or PMI-ACP support the role but do not replace demonstrated RTE experience.
* Relevant examples may include SAFe, Scrum/Agile, ITIL, Lean Portfolio Management or programme and change management qualifications.
* For regulated or GxP-impacting platforms, awareness of applicable quality, validation and compliance expectations is desirable.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Deep knowledge of SAFe practices, including Programme Increment planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt, ART sync and flow based metrics.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled delivery tooling, including responsible use for backlog analysis, reporting and dependency tracking.
* Understanding of platform operating models and product-aligned delivery across engineering teams.

**Related Experience Required**

* Significant experience facilitating Agile Release Trains or large scale agile delivery using the SAFe framework.
* Proven experience coordinating dependencies, risks and impediments across multiple teams, suppliers or platforms.
* Experience facilitating Programme Increment planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt and other core Agile Release Train events.
* Experience using flow metrics such as velocity, predictability and cycle time to drive delivery improvement.
* Experience coaching teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile practices without acting as a single point of control.
* Significant experience coordinating Agile delivery across multiple technology teams or a release train.
* Strong capability in Planning Interval facilitation, dependency and risk management, coaching, and flow metrics.
* Evidence of improving delivery predictability, cycle time, quality or stakeholder alignment.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Release Train Engineer qualification, such as SAFe Release Train Engineer.
* Experience coordinating network or infrastructure transformation delivery.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, portfolio tools or AI assisted delivery practices.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills, able to align teams and stakeholders without formal authority.
* Ability to interpret flow, quality and delivery metrics and convert insight into improvement actions.
* Skilled at managing risk and dependency logs (ROAM) and escalating effectively when blockers cannot be resolved at team level.
* Strong stakeholder management across business, technology and supplier organisations.
* Commitment to continuous learning, AI fluency and adoption of modern Agile and delivery tooling.

**Skills**

Agile Coaching, Arts Facilitation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Defense Management, Flow Meter, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Engineer, Product Manager leads the design, build and adoption of AI and agentic solutions in the Automation Acceleration Hub, combining hands-on AI engineering with product management to turn high-value opportunities into solutions that change how GSK runs technology. It identifies, shapes and prioritises AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, owns the AI product roadmap and backlog, and stays hands-on in design and delivery where that is what moves the work forward. Reliability and responsible-AI guardrails are built into solutions from the start, with explicit service levels for AI services.

The role is deliberately dual: engineering depth and product ownership sit together rather than being split across two people. AI platform architecture sits with the Director, AI Platform Architect, hands-on AI and agent engineering also sits with the Principal AI Engineer / Architect and the Principal AI / Prompt / Agent Engineer, process design sits with the Principal AI Process Architect, and adoption enablement sits with the Principal AI Enablement Lead. Solutions transition to the owning domain as they mature rather than remaining in the Hub indefinitely.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify, shape and prioritise high-value AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, linking each to strategy and to a measurable outcome rather than to a technology.
* Lead the design and delivery of AI and agentic solutions that accelerate delivery and operations, staying hands-on where that is what moves the work forward.
* Own the AI product roadmap and backlog, steering with OKRs and value metrics under lean portfolio principles.
* Build reliability and responsible-AI guardrails into solutions from the start, with clear service levels for AI services rather than best-effort operation.
* Partner with the platform domains to embed solutions in their operations, and transition ownership to them as solutions mature.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:

We are seeking a **Senior Security Architect** to define and guide the technical approach for vulnerability analysis, prioritization, remediation patterns, and engineering enablement across a large-scale portfolio. This role will provide architectural leadership across application security, cloud security, and software supply-chain risk domains, working closely with development, platform, TechOps, and application teams to drive repeatable, scalable remediation practices across an environment of approximately 4,600 repositories, 20 major product groupings, and 1,800 developers.

* Provide architecture and technical leadership for the Vulnerability Management workstream
* Establish approaches for vulnerability analysis, validation, prioritization, and remediation planning
* Guide remediation efforts across application and security code findings, cloud configuration risks, and vulnerable dependencies
* Define reusable fix patterns, remediation playbooks, and technical runbooks
* Support engineers on complex vulnerabilities and root-cause analysis
* Review proof-of-concept fixes and remediation recommendations
* Help product teams reduce recurring vulnerabilities by improving engineering and security practices
* Support risk reporting and recurring vulnerability trend analysis
* Deliver senior architectural guidance while enabling engineers to execute repeatable remediation work at scale

* Understanding of security automation and DevSecOps principles

* Capability to define and guide remediation playbooks and technical runbooks at scale across large, complex portfolios

  + Flexible benefits

description:

**Job Purpose**

The Process Automation Architect determines what should be automated before anything is built. The role analyses end-to-end technology processes across CTO to find inefficiency, manual effort and automation or AI hotspots, quantifies the opportunity, and architects the redesigned process so that automation improves the work rather than encoding the current way of doing it.

This is the front end of the hub's pipeline. It works alongside the other three intake dimensions of workforce, workbench and digital platform, and hands prioritised, evidenced use cases to the Director, Automation Engineering / Product Manager for delivery. * Architect the redesigned process, deciding what should be removed, simplified, automated or made agentic, and in what sequence.

The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across local area network and campus switching to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

**Business Stakeholders**

* Internal GSK teams consuming the platform as customers of its self-service capability
* Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

**Tech Stakeholders**

* Engineering Director as line manager and owner of the engineering roadmap
* Platform Architect for reference architectures, patterns and standards
* Product Owner for backlog order and acceptance of engineering-led items
* Site Reliability Engineer and Reliability Engineering & Operations for SLOs, observability and incident prevention
* Other Principal Engineers and platform engineers across the domain

**Other**

* Managed service partners contributing engineering capacity to the platform.
* Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Why is this level of Education Required?**

* Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering enterprise local area networks and campus switching services.
* Strong knowledge of routing, switching, segmentation, resilience and complex fault diagnosis.
* Evidence of applying standards and automation to improve deployment quality, reliability or supportability.

title: Principal Software Architect - Next Gen Informatics
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Job Description

Principal Software Architect is responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end architecture of high performant, scalable, resilient next-generation laboratory informatics software platform, including instrument connectivity, laboratory workflows, quality control (QC), result management, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong software engineering and architectural expertise with demonstrated experience in **AI-native software development** - requiring the ability to transform conventional engineering workflows into AI-enabled development practices using coding agents, automated code analysis, agentic workflows, AI-assisted testing, and continuous verification while maintaining architectural integrity, security, and product quality.

Key Responsibilities

**Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Own the end-to-end software architecture, including system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, deployment topology, and technology choices.

Define modular, extensible architectures supporting multiple instrument vendors, laboratory sites, product configurations, and deployment environments.

Establish architectural principles, design patterns, interface contracts, coding standards, and reference architectures.

Make informed build-versus-buy and architectural trade-off decisions considering reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and total cost of ownership.

Identify architectural risks, structural technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and opportunities for platform simplification.

Guide architecture evolution and modernization of legacy systems without compromising existing customer workflows or data integrity.

**AI-Native Software Architecture and Engineering**

Define the technical strategy for integrating AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, and maintenance.

Design AI-enabled engineering workflows using coding agents, agentic development environments, codebase intelligence, and automated verification.

Establish architectural context, repository-level instructions, machine-readable specifications, and guardrails that enable AI agents to work safely within complex software systems.

Evaluate AI agent architectures, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and code graph technologies where appropriate.

Establish repeatable evaluations for AI-generated code, including correctness, architectural conformance, test effectiveness, security, maintainability, and regression risk.

Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity without compromising software quality or release integrity.

**Instrument Connectivity and Interoperability Architecture**

Define a reusable connectivity architecture for integrating diagnostic instruments from multiple vendors.

Establish abstractions for protocol adapters, device drivers, message parsing, normalization, acknowledgements, retry, buffering, and recovery.

Guide implementation of TCP/IP and serial communication, vendor-specific protocols, and relevant standards such as CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.

Defining canonical data models and interface contracts for instrument messages, results, QC data, device status, and configuration.

Design for intermittent connectivity, duplicate or malformed messages, out-of-order events, service restarts, and safe recovery.

Establish simulator-based testing and conformance strategies that reduce the cost and complexity of onboarding new instruments.

**Laboratory Domain and Data Architecture**

Translate laboratory workflows and domain requirements into explicit, testable architectural models.

Define architectures for QC management, Levey–Jennings charts, Westgard rules, result review, QC closeout, alerting, and audit trails.

Establish data models and persistence strategies for historical results, QC observations, configuration versions, rule changes, and operator actions.

Ensure deterministic processing, traceability, historical reproducibility, and appropriate handling of concurrent updates.

Key Technical Skills and Experience

**Software Engineering**

15+ years in software engineering, including significant experience in software architecture and technical leadership

Strong proficiency in C#, .NET / .NET Core, object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and software design patterns.

Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant high-performance scalable applications.

Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or comparable frontend frameworks.

Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, automated testing, CI/CD, debugging, security, and production issue resolution.

**Domain Experience - Mandatory**

Deep expertise in laboratory middleware systems, instrument drivers, message translation.

Clinical laboratory workflows, QC processes, result review, and instrument integration.

Laboratory instrument communication standards, including ASTM, CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.

Healthcare IT, LIS, laboratory middleware, diagnostic software, or IVD product development.

Applicable healthcare software lifecycle, quality-management, risk-management, and cybersecurity standards.

**AI-Native Development - Mandatory**

Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools in real software delivery projects.

Ability to design and implement AI-enabled engineering workflows spanning requirements analysis, codebase exploration, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Practical experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent agentic development environments.

Experience creating and maintaining repository-level AI instructions, reusable agent workflows, project context, and engineering guardrails.

Understanding of agent tool use, context windows, structured outputs, model limitations, and techniques for grounding AI-generated changes in actual code and specifications.

Experience integrating AI agents with source control, work items, build pipelines, test frameworks, and other engineering tools.

Ability to establish automated verification & human review mechanisms for AI-generated code.

Demonstrated understanding of AI failure modes, including hallucinated APIs, incorrect assumptions, insecure code, incomplete test coverage, and unintended architectural changes.

Practical knowledge of secure AI usage, confidential-data protection, access controls, auditability, and software licensing considerations.

 **Benefits**  

Job Description

Principal Software Architect is responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end architecture of high performant, scalable, resilient next-generation laboratory informatics software platform, including instrument connectivity, laboratory workflows, quality control (QC), result management, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong software engineering and architectural expertise with demonstrated experience in **AI-native software development** - requiring the ability to transform conventional engineering workflows into AI-enabled development practices using coding agents, automated code analysis, agentic workflows, AI-assisted testing, and continuous verification while maintaining architectural integrity, security, and product quality.

Key Responsibilities

**Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Own the end-to-end software architecture, including system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, deployment topology, and technology choices.

Define modular, extensible architectures supporting multiple instrument vendors, laboratory sites, product configurations, and deployment environments.

Establish architectural principles, design patterns, interface contracts, coding standards, and reference architectures.

Make informed build-versus-buy and architectural trade-off decisions considering reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and total cost of ownership.

Identify architectural risks, structural technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and opportunities for platform simplification.

Guide architecture evolution and modernization of legacy systems without compromising existing customer workflows or data integrity.

**AI-Native Software Architecture and Engineering**

Define the technical strategy for integrating AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, and maintenance.

Design AI-enabled engineering workflows using coding agents, agentic development environments, codebase intelligence, and automated verification.

Establish architectural context, repository-level instructions, machine-readable specifications, and guardrails that enable AI agents to work safely within complex software systems.

Evaluate AI agent architectures, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and code graph technologies where appropriate.

Establish repeatable evaluations for AI-generated code, including correctness, architectural conformance, test effectiveness, security, maintainability, and regression risk.

Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity without compromising software quality or release integrity.

**Instrument Connectivity and Interoperability Architecture**

Define a reusable connectivity architecture for integrating diagnostic instruments from multiple vendors.

Establish abstractions for protocol adapters, device drivers, message parsing, normalization, acknowledgements, retry, buffering, and recovery.

Guide implementation of TCP/IP and serial communication, vendor-specific protocols, and relevant standards such as CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.

Defining canonical data models and interface contracts for instrument messages, results, QC data, device status, and configuration.

Design for intermittent connectivity, duplicate or malformed messages, out-of-order events, service restarts, and safe recovery.

Establish simulator-based testing and conformance strategies that reduce the cost and complexity of onboarding new instruments.

**Laboratory Domain and Data Architecture**

Translate laboratory workflows and domain requirements into explicit, testable architectural models.

Define architectures for QC management, Levey–Jennings charts, Westgard rules, result review, QC closeout, alerting, and audit trails.

Establish data models and persistence strategies for historical results, QC observations, configuration versions, rule changes, and operator actions.

Ensure deterministic processing, traceability, historical reproducibility, and appropriate handling of concurrent updates.

Key Technical Skills and Experience

**Software Engineering**

15+ years in software engineering, including significant experience in software architecture and technical leadership

Strong proficiency in C#, .NET / .NET Core, object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and software design patterns.

Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant high-performance scalable applications.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Photos
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

title: AI Operations Engineer
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Your Impact

our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities

Evaluate and introduce AI-powered development and testing tools, and measure their real impact on quality and speed

* Proven experience writing Test Plans and Test Strategies for complex projects
* Experience building automation frameworks from scratch (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, TestNG/JUnit, or similar)

* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with Jira and test management tools (TestRail, Xray, or similar)

* Practical experience using AI assistants and coding tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) in daily development and testing, with the judgment to validate and correct their output
* Prompt engineering skills for producing reliable code, test cases, and test data
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to switch between building and testing, and to lead by example

* Microservices architecture and event-driven design
* Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)

ISTQB or AI certifications

title: Mainframe Storage Support, System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

The Mainframe Storage Support Specialist will provide expert-level support for enterprise mainframe storage environments, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance of mission-critical services. The role involves administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and implementation of storage solutions across complex z/OS environments.

  

**What you will do**

* Provide day-to-day support for IBM mainframe storage infrastructure and associated technologies.
* Manage and maintain DASD storage subsystems, storage allocation, and performance optimization.
* Support IBM DFSMS components, including SMS, ACS routines, HSM, DFP, DSS, and RMM.
* Administer and support storage hardware and software platforms such as IBM DS8K, FlashSystem, and related storage technologies.
* Perform incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution for storage-related issues.
* Participate in change management activities, including implementation planning, risk assessment, testing, and execution.
* Monitor storage utilization, analyze trends, and perform capacity management activities to ensure future growth requirements are met.
Support  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience supporting IBM Mainframe Storage environments, with strong knowledge of IBM z/OS operating systems and storage architecture.
* Hands-on experience with the DFSMS suite (SMS, DFHSM/HSM, DFDSS, ICKDSF, RMM, IDCAMS, ISMF).
* Hands-on experience supporting IBM DS8000 storage platforms.
Practical experience managing backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery processes.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Deep understanding of DASD management, storage provisioning, performance tuning, and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with storage monitoring/reporting tools and incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to support critical systems under tight operational and SLA requirements.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering (or equivalent experience) and strong English communication skills.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Corporate Strategy professionals shape Kyndryl's long-term direction and growth by leading high-impact, cross-functional initiatives and supporting executive decision-making. They partner closely with senior leaders to develop and execute enterprise strategies, leverage market, financial, customer, and competitive insights, and solve complex business challenges that drive growth and enterprise value.

* Demonstrated expertise developing GTM and pricing strategies for managed services, cloud services, software / SaaS, IT infrastructure, or hybrid technology offerings

* Skilled in gathering and synthesizing data, conducting market research, competitive benchmarking, customer research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations

* Ability to lead independent workstreams within larger corporate strategy initiatives and influence stakeholders across Offering, Sales, Finance, Delivery, Legal, and executive leadership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for developing executive and board-level presentations, pricing recommendations, decision memos, and implementation roadmaps
Extensive customer-facing or stakeholder-facing exposure with strong commercial acumen, including familiarity with enterprise procurement dynamics, deal economics, and technology services / software sales cycles

* Experience supporting pricing transformations, portfolio simplification, commercial governance, go-to-market redesign, sales enablement, or partner monetization programs
* Familiarity with pricing analytics, CRM / CPQ workflows, cloud financial management / FinOps, product management practices, or software licensing operations
Industry certifications or training in cloud platforms, FinOps, pricing, product management, strategic finance, or related disciplines

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.
