title: Principal Digital Design Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Description:**

The Digital IP team within Analog Devices Inc. is responsible for developing, curating, and providing reusable strategic IPs to Business Units to accelerate product development across the company. The team is looking for an experienced **Digital Design Lead** who will be responsible for providing technical leadership to the digital design team, while managing IP development and delivery.

The ideal candidate would be someone with strong technical background combined with management acumen and demonstrable ability to handle ambiguity while still finding creative ways to make things happen.

A key focus area for this position includes interacting and engaging with internal customers to communicate, identify, improve, and maintain developed IP, as well as scout for 3rd party IPs and evaluate them on a regular basis for future requirements.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Provide technical leadership and expertise to a team of design engineers on all aspects of digital design & quality assurance** (CDC, Low Power design, Synthesis & timing closure, Design for Test improvements, silicon debug etc)
* **Architect and Design** **key digital blocks** such as accelerators/ data path IP in Verilog/ System Verilog with built-in configurability to allow Power/ Performance/ Area tradeoffs
* **Demonstrate strong understanding of heterogenous processor cores & subsystems** (A55/ M55/ M4/ U55/ RISC-V/ DSP core, and associated infrastructure such as caches, interconnect fabric, GIC, DMA, MMU, Coresight Debug & Trace, TZC, SMPU, SPU) and their integration requirements
* Work closely with all stakeholders, including product teams, project managers, senior managers & leadership team to align team schedules, milestones, commitments, deliverables
* **Conduct detail-oriented design reviews** and drive adherence to quality metrics
* Create and manage a streamlined workflow for the design team that enables them to work collaboratively and efficiently. This includes creating a project visibility system and setting up design review processes to establish a clear scheme of design delivery
* **Drive efforts towards development of Design Management and IP Centric infrastructure and flows** across different tools such as Methodics / Perforce / Github / IP catalog creation etc
* **Develop and maintain catalog of digital IPs** to enable ease of information sharing to customers across different BUs
* **Lead the way to build deep expertise on complex interfaces** , peripherals & protocols such as DDR, Ethernet, eMMC/ SD, MIPI, Display Port, HDMI, PCIe, high speed D2D
* **Package Digital IP for seamless integration** into design flow at different stages – RTL/ constraints/ CDC waivers, timing wavers, DFT DRCs and waivers, software programming sequence etc.
* **Drive evaluation of 3rd party IPs** on Power/ Performance/ Area (PPA) and other key qualitative aspects such as design quality, Design For Testability, robustness of Design Verification (DV) practice, ease of integration and make recommendations
* **Establish evaluation flows** for home-grown & 3rd party IPs for consistent benchmarking of evaluation
* Manage & streamline efforts towards consolidation/ curation of digital IP blocks, such as standard peripherals, processor cores & collaterals, high speed protocol & interface IP
* Strive to remove complexity and ambiguity within the teams and their processes. Ability to distil and provide clear and actionable recommendations to the team

**Position Requirements** :

* Minimum B.E. /B. Tech degree in Electrical/Electronics/Computer science
* 15+ years of relevant experience with a strong focus on definition/ architecture/ u-arch/ design and hands-on RTL coding experience using Verilog and System-Verilog
* Strong understanding of all aspects of ASIC/SoC product development incl Design Verification/ timing constraints/ closure, physical implementation, quality assurance flows with hands-on prior experience in a few of these aspects
* Proven experience in managing/ handling large complex hardware projects in lead role
* Strong understanding of control path and data-path digital design concepts with an eye for realizing correct by construction solutions
* Experience with specifying Design Verification (DV) requirements such as test plans, coverage metrics, and evaluate DV quality so as to realize robust design quality
* Strong knowledge of Lint, CDC, formal equivalence, DFT concepts, power analysis, low power design
* Experience with developing timing constraints and ability to carry out logic synthesis and Static timing analysis
* Ability to technically mentor a large digital design team
* Good interpersonal, teamwork and communication skills to drive discussions logically & effectively with teams spread geographically
* Strong understanding of standard on-chip interfaces such as APB/AHB/AXI/ Stream protocols
* Knowledge of Processor/SoC architecture and/or DSP fundamentals

Serve as the focal point for communications. Compile regular status updates for all stakeholders and effectively escalate critical issues and risks as necessary

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

  

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Job Purpose**

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Storage/Backup builds and runs Storage and Backup Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

* Understanding of modern storage and backup technologies (Caching Services, Object Storage, distributed storage, SDS, Continuous Data Protection, Storage-as-a-service, Backup-as-a-service) undefined
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.

* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* undefined

* undefined

title: Junior Architect
description:
About the Role

The Out Factory is looking for a Junior Architect to join our design team and help shape the next generation of glamping spaces. This role sits at the intersection of architecture and product design: you will draft layouts and drawings for real projects (predominantly circular / round forms) while also contributing to the design and prototyping of new glamping products. It's a strong fit for someone who is equally comfortable behind a drafting table and out on site.

Key Responsibilities

* Draft floor plans, masterplans, interior layouts, working drawings, and MEP drawings, all designed within circular/round geometries.
* Design new glamping products, from concept through material research and physical prototyping.
* Build accurate, presentation-ready 3D models of designs for internal review, client presentations, and construction reference.
* Coordinate directly with clients to understand requirements and communicate design intent.
* Coordinate with site teams and contractors to ensure drawings are correctly interpreted and executed on the ground.
* Support material research and sourcing for both built structures and product prototypes.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture.
* 0–2 years of experience; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Strong proficiency in 3D modelling software, SketchUp preferred and Rhino.
* Solid drafting skills, including working drawings and coordination with MEP layouts.
* Comfort designing within non-standard, curved/circular geometries.
* A hands-on interest in materials, prototyping, and product development, not just building design.
* Good communication skills for client-facing and site coordination work.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as needed.

Why Join Us

You'll work on distinctive, non-conventional architecture and gain hands-on exposure across the full lifecycle of a project, from first sketch to on-site execution, alongside product design and prototyping work you won't find in a typical architecture role.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Tririga Consultant
description:

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This role involves the development and application of engineering practice and knowledge in designing, managing and improving the processes for Industrial operations, including procurement, supply chain and facilities engineering and maintenance of the facilities. ------------------------------------

title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer - IaaS
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - IaaS builds and runs the IaaS Platform and Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as DevOps, Cloud Engineering / Architecture
* Deep expertise in Windows Server and/or Linux Operating Systems
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

  

* Azure, AWS, and GCP certifications
* undefined
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts

  

* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevSecOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform.

The engineer will contribute across user experiences, APIs, microservices, data and messaging infrastructure and containerized deployments.

You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. * Modern full-stack application development

* Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering

* RESTful APIs and backend service development

* .NET and C# development

* Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing
* + RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology

* + Authentication, authorization, and secure API design

  + Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments

  + Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems

  + Kubernetes-based edge deployments

  + Device and gateway management

* Identify technical risks, dependencies, maintainability concerns, and integration issues early.

description:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Responsibilities:

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Platform Optimization & Org Health**

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

Qualifications:

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* AI supply chain security and model governance

title: Mainframe zOS Administration Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-class z/OS storage solutions to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Lead the architecture and governance of DFSMS and SMS environments, including Storage Groups, Data Classes, Storage Classes, Management Classes, and ACS routines.
* Manage DASD capacity planning, storage optimization, hardware upgrades, and long-term growth strategies.
* Administer and support VTOC, VTOCIX, catalogs, DFSMShsm, and DFSMSdss, ensuring efficient data lifecycle management and recoverability.
* Monitor storage performance, analyze I/O workloads, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive root cause resolution for critical incidents.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities across the storage environment.
* Collaborate with security teams to maintain compliance with audit, regulatory, and access control requirements.
* Lead strategic initiatives including storage modernization, hardware refreshes, data center migrations, z/OS upgrades, cloud integration, automation, and disaster recovery enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, JCL, ISPF, and vendor tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for storage-related issues, providing expert guidance and operational leadership.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams to deliver storage services that align with business objectives.
Mentor junior engineers and system programmers, promote knowledge sharing, and contribute to the development of standards, procedures, and best practices.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 10+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 oncall support to resolve any system issues.
* Working knowledge of mainframe GDPS.
* Good understanding of flip and stay disaster recovery model.
* Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.
Should provide recommendations on optimizing system performance.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience in z/OS administration.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

About Marvell
  
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
  
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
  
Your Team, Your Impact  
  
Within this ecosystem, Marvell’s central advanced packaging organization plays a critical role in delivering next generation connectivity and compute products. The organization brings deep expertise in architecture, package design, and electrical performance, including SI/PI to develop advanced IC packages that support high speed interfaces. This work directly shapes product performance, reliability, and time to market, making it a key contributor to Marvell’s overall technology leadership.

**What You Can Expect**

**What You Can Expect**

* Marvell’s Central Engineering team is seeking a talented High-speed IC package development engineer to contribute to the development of advanced microelectronic packages.
* The engineer will be responsible for driving microelectronic package development from concept through tapeout, working with package architects and technical leads to select appropriate technologies and ensure manufacturability, performance, reliability, and cost compliance.
* Key responsibilities include developing C4 and BGA ball maps optimized for SI/PI and layout efficiency; planning and validating netlist mappings across dies, interposers, and substrates; and defining die placement, padstacks, net assignments, and package‑level connectivity.
* The engineer will create and maintain Package Requirement Documents (PRDs) detailing die arrangements, stackups, and design constraints.

**What We're Looking For**

**What We're Looking For**

  

* 8+ years of related professional experience.

* Previous experience developing netlists and schematics for large, complex packages.
* Previous experience developing C4 and BGA ball maps for high‑pin‑count designs.
* Proficiency with design tools Cadence OrbitIO / Integrity System Planner (ISP) or equivalent
* Strong foundational understanding of package design, including design rules, breakout, place and route, signal shielding, reference planes, power distribution, and pinout optimization across package and system requirements.
* Solid grasp of SI/PI fundamentals at the substrate, board, and system levels; familiarity with running and interpreting signal and power simulations is a plus.
* Knowledge of 2D, 2.5D, and emerging packaging architectures such as CoWoS‑S/R/L, EMIB, CPO, and CPC.
* High‑level understanding of thermal and mechanical package constraints (e.g., warpage, TIM).
* Experience contributing to tool, process, and flow development, including library maintenance and basic scripting for automation.
* Familiarity with foundry design rules and substrate manufacturing constraints.
* Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional teams and global time zones; strong interpersonal skills and willingness to learn.
* Experience collaborating with chip and board design and electrical simulation teams to optimize package and system co‑design.
* Experience collaborating with chip and board design, and electrical simulation teams for co‑design and optimization.
* Strong communication, presentation, and documentation skills.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - AI platform engineering and Salesforce project delivery
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

  
  

**Job Description**

**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior Technical Consultant** is a hands-on technical role spanning **AI platform engineering and Salesforce project delivery** . The role will contribute to building and enhancing the organization's multi-agent AI delivery platform, while also using the platform and agentic development approaches to deliver Salesforce projects.
  
The platform brings together multiple LLMs, public AI models, agents, tools, and workflows to support the Salesforce delivery lifecycle. The Senior Technical Consultant will help evolve these capabilities, support projects adopting the platform, and work as a senior Salesforce developer on delivery projects using **AI-first and agentic development practices** .
  
The ideal candidate combines strong **Salesforce engineering expertise with AI/LLM and agentic development skills** , and can build solutions, solve complex problems, and guide other developers in adopting new ways of working.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **AI Platform Engineering**

* Develop and enhance the organization's **multi-agent AI application** , including agents, tools, workflows, integrations, and automations.
* Work with multiple LLMs and public AI models and evaluate their suitability for different use cases.
* Implement agent orchestration, tool use, prompting, context management, grounding, and workflow execution.
* Build reusable AI capabilities that can be leveraged across Salesforce projects.
* Prototype new AI capabilities and convert successful PoCs into production-ready solutions.
* Continuously experiment with emerging AI frameworks, models, and developer tools.

### **Agentic Salesforce Delivery**

* Work as a **Senior Resource** on delivery projects, using AI and agentic development approaches to accelerate and improve delivery.
* Use the AI platform and associated agents, tools, and workflows across the Salesforce development lifecycle.
* Apply agentic approaches to activities including **analysis, design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and deployment** .
* Build and review Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, APIs, and other Salesforce technologies.
* Ensure AI-assisted and AI-generated solutions meet Salesforce architecture, security, quality, and engineering standards.
* Identify opportunities within projects to automate repetitive development activities and improve developer productivity.

### **Platform Support & Problem Solving**

* Support Salesforce projects using the AI delivery platform and resolve incoming technical issues.
* Diagnose problems across the application, agents, LLMs, prompts, tools, integrations, and Salesforce components.
* Work with **Technical Architects and the AI application owner** to identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
* Identify recurring project issues and convert solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
* Feed project experience and user feedback into continuous improvement of the AI platform.

### **Enablement & Technical Leadership**

* Guide Salesforce developers and project teams in **agentic ways of working and AI-assisted development** .
* Help teams understand how and when to use agents, AI tools, and platform capabilities effectively.
* Establish and share practical patterns, best practices, and lessons learned from real project delivery.
* Collaborate with Technical Architects and the AI application owner to drive adoption and improve delivery outcomes.

### **Builder & Engineering Mindset**

* Be a hands-on developer who **builds and ships working solutions** , rather than primarily a design/documentation role.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as **Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and similar tools** .
* Follow modern engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, testing, code reviews, and maintainable design.
* Balance rapid experimentation with scalability, security, reliability, and production quality.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **5–7 years of Salesforce/software engineering experience** with strong hands-on Salesforce development skills.
* Strong experience with **Apex, LWC, SOQL, Flow, APIs, integrations, and Salesforce metadata** .
* Experience building **multi-agent or agentic AI applications** .
* Experience working with multiple LLM providers/models.
* Experience with **MCP, agent orchestration, RAG, vector search, or LLM evaluation** .
* Hands-on experience with **Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, or similar AI coding tools** .
* Experience integrating AI applications with Salesforce APIs, metadata, repositories, or development environments.
* Experience with Agentforce or other enterprise AI/agent platforms.
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or System Architect.

**Key Attributes**
------------------

* **Builder:** Comfortable building and shipping both Salesforce and AI solutions.
* **AI Practitioner:** Uses AI and agentic approaches as part of day-to-day development.
* **Salesforce Technologist:** Strong understanding of enterprise Salesforce development and architecture.
* **Problem Solver:** Can debug issues across AI, application, integration, and Salesforce layers.
* **Enabler:** Helps other developers and teams adopt agentic ways of working.
* **Product Mindset:** Turns project learnings into reusable platform capabilities.
* **Collaborator:** Works closely with architects, the AI platform owner, and delivery teams.

**Success in the Role**
-----------------------

Success means **improving the AI delivery platform while delivering Salesforce projects more effectively through agentic development** .
  
The Senior Technical Consultant will act as a key **bridge between AI platform engineering and Salesforce delivery** — building the platform, using it to deliver real projects, solving adoption and technical challenges, and enabling other developers to adopt agentic ways of working.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

description:

**Your Team, Your Impact**

The Marvell Advanced Packaging team is responsible for package designs  
that meet challenging electrical requirements. High speed signaling and challenging power delivery networks require complex and custom solutions to meet constantly advancing application needs. Many of the new designs require multi-chip and multiple component configurations with high-speed IP requirements. In addition, our team is advancing Marvell's expertise in 3D packaging, Co-packaged optics and cutting-edge substrate materials. We work with the world's leading manufacturers to solve our client's most challenging designs and integrations with industry-leading packaging techniques.

**What You Can Expect**

**What You Can Expect**

* Marvell’s Central Engineering team is seeking a talented High-speed IC package development engineer to contribute to the development of advanced microelectronic packages.
* The engineer will be responsible for driving microelectronic package development from concept through tapeout, working with package architects and technical leads to select appropriate technologies and ensure manufacturability, performance, reliability, and cost compliance.

**What We're Looking For**

**What We're Looking For**

  

* 4+ years of related professional experience.

* Proficiency with industry-standard IC package layout tools such as Cadence APD or Siemens (Mentor) Xpedition (XPD)
* Strong understanding of IC package design requirements for high-speed interfaces, including constraints definition and implementation
* Experience collaborating with substrate suppliers, OSATs, and silicon fabrication partners to drive successful design execution

* Knowledge of IC packaging technologies, materials, substrate design rules, and assembly constraints
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) from concept through development and production is a plus
* Ability to collaborate with ASIC physical design teams to optimize die floorplan for improved package integration and system performance is a plus

* High‑level understanding of thermal and mechanical package constraints (e.g., warpage, TIM).
* Experience contributing to tool, process, and flow development, including library maintenance and basic scripting for automation.
* Familiarity with foundry design rules and substrate manufacturing constraints.
* Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional teams and global time zones; strong interpersonal skills and willingness to learn.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

Overview  
  
  

**Account Manager –Digital Factory Solutions**

  

**Your mission**

From shopfloor connectivity to AI-enabled manufacturing operations, you show decision-makers how our solutions create measurable value: more resilient operations, better planning, empowered workers and connected data across IT and OT.

We are seeking a 12+ experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, SQL Data Warehouse, and modern cloud data platforms to define and implement scalable, secure, high-performance data architectures.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into robust enterprise data architecture and solution designs, defining data platforms, integration patterns, data models, governance frameworks, and analytics solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, BI teams, application teams, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver scalable and cost-effective data solutions.

The Data Architect will provide technical leadership across batch and real-time data processing, Lakehouse/Data Warehouse architecture, data integration, data modeling, data governance, security, Power BI, and cloud data platforms**.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Architecture & Solution Design**

* Good exposure to work on RFP’s, sales proposal, technical and estimate.

**Microsoft Fabric & Databricks Architecture**

* Define enterprise architecture using Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows, Power BI, and related Fabric capabilities.
* Design scalable Azure Databricks and Delta Lake architectures for large-scale data processing and analytics.
* Define Bronze, Silver, and Gold data-layer strategies and standards.
* Design Databricks solutions using Apache Spark, Structured Streaming, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and optimized data processing patterns.
* Define standards for partitioning, file sizes, schema evolution, incremental processing, data retention, and performance optimization.
* Guide teams in optimizing Databricks workloads for performance and cloud cost efficiency.

**Data Integration & ETL/ELT Architecture**

* Design data integration architectures for data originating from databases, APIs, files, SaaS applications, Dynamics 365, and streaming sources.
* Define appropriate batch, micro-batch, and real-time/streaming ingestion patterns.
* Establish ETL/ELT patterns using ADF, Fabric Data Factory, Databricks, and other cloud-native services.
* Define frameworks for incremental loads, CDC, SCD Type 1/Type 2, reconciliation, error handling, and data recovery.
* Design reusable and scalable data ingestion frameworks.

**Data Modelling & Data Architecture**

* Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models based on business requirements.
* Design dimensional models, star schemas, fact and dimension tables, and analytical data models.
* Define enterprise data standards, naming conventions, data domains, and master/reference data structures.
* Design models optimized for Power BI, analytics, reporting, and downstream applications.
* Define strategies for managing historical data, slowly changing dimensions, data retention, and archival.

**Data Governance, Security & Compliance**

* Define enterprise data governance and security architecture across the data platform.
* Implement and govern Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, RBAC, data classification, lineage, auditing, and access-control strategies.
* Define security patterns for row-level security, column-level security, masking, encryption, secrets management, and secure data access.
* Establish data ownership, data stewardship, metadata, lineage, and data quality standards.

**Performance, Scalability & Cost Optimization**

* Define architecture strategies to support high-volume and high-performance data workloads.
* Identify and resolve architectural bottlenecks across ingestion, storage, transformation, database, and reporting layers.
* Optimize Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, Fabric, SQL, and Power BI workloads.
* Define appropriate compute sizing, workload isolation, partitioning, caching, indexing, and optimization strategies.
* Perform capacity planning, scalability assessment, and cost optimization for cloud data platforms.

**Cloud & Technology Architecture**

* Design cloud-based data solutions primarily on Microsoft Azure, with knowledge of AWS/GCP data platforms.

* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions based on business requirements and architectural standards.

The Customer Success Unit brings together deep technical expertise and customer success leadership to help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and realize value from their Microsoft investments. Data and AI sit at the center of every organization's transformation, and our customers are looking to Microsoft to help them modernize their data estates, unlock insights, and build secure, responsible, production-grade AI solutions.

As the Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) Manager – Data & AI, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of Cloud Solution Architects who help customers and partners design, deploy, and scale solutions across Microsoft's Data & AI portfolio — including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, Power BI, Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry), Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and agentic AI solutions. You will guide the team in translating customer business challenges into data and AI architectures, removing technical blockers, driving operational readiness, accelerating consumption and usage growth, and delivering solutions aligned with Microsoft methodologies and proven practices.

This opportunity will allow you to strengthen your people leadership, deepen your expertise in data platforms and AI, and help scale repeatable Data & AI patterns and best practices across a diverse portfolio of strategic customers.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

 **Responsibilities**

Business Impact

* Coaches the team on operating to required operational excellence and proven practice standards across all engagement stages, activities, and tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, consumption tracking, time tracking).

* Leads the team in orchestrating across Microsoft account teams, specialists, partners, and customer teams to deliver on-strategy Data & AI outcomes and increase customer and partner satisfaction.

* Oversees the team in anticipating and managing business and technical risks for data and AI workloads — including data quality, data governance, model performance, cost, and Responsible AI considerations — applying governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize risk.

* Leads the team in delivering solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., value-based deliverables [VBDs], architecture design sessions, technical validation, training), ensuring proven patterns are followed so customers are operationally ready to run data and AI workloads in production.

* Coaches the team on guiding customers toward well-architected (secure, resilient, governed, AI-ready), cost- and performance-optimized data platforms and AI solutions that increase retention and expansion opportunities.

* Drives the team to proactively identify cross-solution opportunities for Data & AI consumption, usage, and Unified expansion (including Enhanced Solutions) — such as data estate modernization, analytics migration to Microsoft Fabric, generative AI and agentic applications, and Copilot extensibility — based on clear business value to the customer.

* Guides the team on articulating the value of Unified and partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with the right Data & AI services. Leads feedback to the Unified Delivery team on Data & AI VBDs to refine and further develop content.

* Leverages change management proven practices (or engages the change management team) to help customers drive long-term organizational adoption of data and AI solutions, including data literacy and AI adoption.

* Drives the team on anticipating, identifying, escalating, and mitigating blockers — such as data readiness, platform limits, capacity and quota, security reviews, and skills gaps — to accelerate deployment, value realization, and consumption.

* Leads the team to capture opportunities in appropriate systems and tools, working collaboratively across the organization in alignment with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.

Customer Centricity

* Coaches the team to focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery and a seamless, connected customer experience; drives realization of customer conditions of success.

* Leads the team in anticipating and resolving customer dissatisfaction through customer confidence calls, and in executing strategies to improve experience, value realization, and speed of transformation.

* Supports the team in translating customer business problems into Data & AI solutions aligned with Microsoft's platform strategy — explaining how they meet business outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals through proofs of concept, minimum viable products (MVPs), and rapid prototypes, relative to competitive offerings.

* Coaches the team on building trusted relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C-suite — including Chief Data Officers (CDOs), Chief Data & Analytics Officers, Chief AI Officers, CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs — and bridging understanding between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs).

* Elevates engagements with CXO stakeholders on data governance, data privacy, security, compliance, and Responsible AI requirements, engaging additional subject matter experts where deeper expertise is required.

* Leads the team in acting as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and technical input with Engineering, Product, and internal communities. Coaches the team on identifying patterns across customers to develop actionable insights and on presenting business cases that influence product roadmaps and bug-fix prioritization.

Partner Specialization

* Actively orchestrates initiatives, leveraging an expansive knowledge of the Data & AI partner ecosystem to select and champion the most qualified partners for complex customer projects.

* Collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) stakeholders and Partner Technology Specialist (PTS) leadership to translate Data & AI opportunities into action, fostering technical and solution coherence across Microsoft partner and sales ecosystems.

* Concentrates on identifying and prioritizing opportunities that align with the organization's strategic revenue and consumption goals, directing partner and sales support through proofs of concept and technical pre-sales guidance.

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

* Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

* Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

* Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual's capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Technical Leadership

* Leads the team in identifying gaps through delivery and connecting patterns across business and technology areas to drive improvements to products, intellectual property (IP), and practices that enable Data & AI solutions to scale across customers.

* Coaches the team on contributing to Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Cloud Adoption Framework for data and AI, Well-Architected Framework, Responsible AI Standard).

* Leads the team in contributing to and building reusable IP — reference architectures, accelerators, and solution patterns — especially where no IP exists yet (e.g., generative AI, AI agents, Copilot extensibility, RAG, and real-time intelligence scenarios).

* Enables the team to lead and assemble virtual teams (v-teams) around Data & AI technologies and customer challenges, sharing insights with technical communities across the field using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and the competitive landscape (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud).

* Drives recognition for Microsoft Data & AI solutions by leading and encouraging the team's participation in internal and external events (e.g., Ignite, Build, Fabric Community Conference, Tech Connect, meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons).

* Uses market insights and demand signals to help leadership prioritize up-skilling and accreditations. Drives the team to role-model technical readiness — depth in Data & AI (data engineering, analytics, data science, MLOps/LLMOps, generative and agentic AI) and breadth across CSU priorities such as security, resilience, and AI.

* Ensures team members dedicate time to continuous learning and certification, monitoring progress and providing guidance where appropriate.

 **Qualifications**

Required/Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or related field AND 8+ years of experience in data platforms, analytics, AI/machine learning, cloud technologies, technology consulting, software development, solution architecture, and/or practice development; OR equivalent experience.

* 3+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects, consultants, or technical specialist teams.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

* 6+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with hands-on experience designing and delivering data and AI solutions.

* 6+ years of experience leading technical projects, teams, or functions.

* Strong working knowledge of modern data and AI architectures (e.g., lakehouse, data mesh, real-time analytics, MLOps, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents) and Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Power BI, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, and Azure OpenAI.

* Understanding of data governance, security, and Responsible AI principles and tooling (e.g., Microsoft Purview).

* Technical certifications in data and AI (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent).

* 5+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects or consulting practice managers.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**
