title: Senior IT Analyst Applications
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Roles and Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand dealer order-planning, product-structure, interface, data, reporting, and operational-planning needs.
* Collect, analyze, document, and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and traceability for application changes.
* Assess enhancement requests and production issues, clarify business value and impact, and support backlog refinement with product and technical teams.
* Level 4 support for product incidents, service requests, data issues, and recurring defects; analyze application behavior, interfaces, logs, batch dependencies, and business impact to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate development requests with developers, database teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity partners, and vendors; validate that fixes address the documented business need.
* Manage enhancements and code fixes from demand intake through implementation, including scope clarification, test planning, business validation, release readiness, and post-production verification.
* Develop functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios; coordinate test execution, document evidence, manage defects, and confirm solution quality.
* Create and maintain application support procedures, interface inventories, data mappings, knowledge articles, and business continuity or recovery instructions.
* Facilitate communication between business and technical teams by translating business needs into clear solution requirements and technical issues into understandable business impacts and options.
* Identify opportunities for product modernization, process simplification, automation, improved controls, stronger monitoring, and reduced manual support effort.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, vendors, and business users throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, solution analysis, application support, product support, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications and coordinating production incident, problem, change, and release activities.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate business-process, application, interface, and data issues.
* Experience developing test scenarios, coordinating user acceptance testing, managing defects, and validating production changes.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, interfaces, batch processing, and system integration or data-flow analysis.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and manage work across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong skills in accountability, organization, collaboration, customer focus, and managing priorities under time constraints.

**Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning, dealer demand or order planning, order management, product configuration, bill of materials, or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of S&OP business processes, data structures, batch cycles, interfaces, controls, and downstream dependencies.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET and Python applications sufficient to support requirement analysis, issue triage, testing, and collaboration with developers.
* Experience with Oracle, Snowflake, Windows Server, FTP or secure file transfer, load-balanced applications, and operational-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

**What You Will Have**

**Business Analysis:** Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.

**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.

**Application Delivery Process:** Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.

**System and Technology Integration:** Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.

**Software Quality Management:** Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.

**Problem Management:** Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.

**Information Security Technologies:** Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.

**Stakeholder Management:** Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

**What You Will Get**

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

**Additional Information**

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.

Skill Descriptors  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

  
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

  
Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

  
System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

  
System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

  
Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Sr Engineer - Systems Architecture and Desig
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Job Description Summary
  
  
The Sr Engineer - Systems Architecture and Design is a senior technical role within PCS Hardware Platforms, providing shared systems-design leadership for Common OS and Common UI platform releases. The role ensures that both platforms meet system and product needs, comply with applicable medical-device standards and internal quality-system requirements, and are released with appropriate quality, traceability, risk controls, and technical evidence.  
  
  
  
The role aligns subsystem requirements, architecture, interfaces, design controls, verification strategies, technical reviews, release evidence, and lifecycle decisions across Common OS and Common UI. The Sr Engineer works with System Architects, Product Owners, platform and component architects, verification leaders, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, program teams, and consuming product teams.
  
  
The position coordinates cross-platform dependencies, compatible baselines, integration milestones, product adoption, and consolidated release readiness. The role requires strong systems thinking, embedded software and Linux platform knowledge, reusable UI platform understanding, medical-device development rigor, and the ability to lead complex technical work through influence.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  

* Own subsystem requirement definitions derived from system requirements, user needs, intended use, and platform strategy; ensure flow-down to design outputs, component requirements, interfaces, and verification evidence.
* Provide shared systems-design leadership for coordinated Common OS and Common UI releases, including joint planning, dependency management, integration milestones, readiness reviews, and release decisions.
* Lead system decomposition, interface definition, architecture-to-requirement traceability, critical-to-quality attributes, non-functional requirements, and documented technical trade-offs.
* Balance safety, security, privacy, usability, performance, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, cost, reuse, and lifecycle sustainability.
* Own the subsystem Design History File strategy and ensure completeness, consistency, traceability, and audit readiness of engineering evidence.
* Define subsystem verification strategies and ensure bidirectional traceability among requirements, risks, verification methods, results, anomalies, and release decisions.
* Ensure subsystem and component Technical Design Review strategies align with system plans and the needs of Common OS and Common UI.
* Lead product and subsystem risk profiling based on intended use, safety, privacy, and cybersecurity; drive FMEA, FTA, risk-benefit analysis, and risk-control traceability.
* Define and monitor platform-health metrics covering quality, reliability, cybersecurity, defect trends, performance, technical debt, obsolescence, and adoption.
* Review product-to-platform and Common OS-to-Common UI interface requirements; maintain clear interface ownership, compatibility expectations, and supported version combinations.
* Drive integrated validation with product teams, including interface, compatibility, performance, upgrade, failure-recovery, cybersecurity, and regression considerations.
* Establish integrated Common OS and Common UI release-readiness reviews covering dependencies, risks, verification evidence, deviations, known limitations, and product-consumption readiness.
* Coordinate defect triage and technical decisions for issues crossing operating system, UI framework, middleware, application, hardware, or product boundaries.
* Conceptualize and drive proofs of concept for new platform capabilities and influence Common OS, Common UI, process, and engineering-tool roadmaps.
* Mentor engineers and emerging system designers in systems engineering, design controls, risk management, technical reviews, and evidence-based decision making.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* Typically 10+ years of engineering experience, including substantial experience in systems architecture and design, embedded software, platform engineering, or medical-device development.
* Demonstrated experience translating system and product needs into subsystem requirements, interfaces, design outputs, verification strategies, and traceable release evidence.
* Experience with regulated product development, design controls, risk management, quality systems, and cross-functional technical reviews.
* Technical depth in embedded Linux architecture and development, middleware or application architecture, cybersecurity, reusable platform technologies, and Qt/QML application development.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as C or C++, with scripting experience using Python and/or shell.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, products, sites, or business stakeholders through influence.

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing and sustaining reusable platforms consumed by multiple medical-device products.
* Experience coordinating releases across interdependent operating-system and user-interface platform areas.
* Experience with Yocto Project or Buildroot, Linux BSPs, bootloaders, device drivers, NXP or TI application processors, and hands-on Qt/QML development for embedded user interfaces.
* Working knowledge of INCOSE-aligned systems-engineering practices, requirements modelling, interface management, CTQs, FMEA, FTA, and risk-benefit analysis.
* Experience with Agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, automated verification, configuration management, SBOM practices, lifecycle vulnerability management, and defect management.
* Experience across concept, new product introduction, sustaining engineering, installed-base support, obsolescence, and end-of-life phases.
* Ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams, quality and regulatory partners, product stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated commitment to acting with humility, leading with transparency, delivering with focus, driving ownership, and operating with unyielding integrity.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Our **total rewards** are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**Additional Information**
==========================

title: Principal DFT design Engineer
description:
Principal / Sr Principal DFT design Engineer

Exp : 10-14 Years

We are seeking a skilled Design for Test (DFT) Principal / Sr Principal / Architect/Lead/Manager to join our team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the testability and manufacturability of our ASIC/SoC products designed for the automotive, Industrial & Consumer applications. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in DFT methodologies and will lead a team of engineers to develop robust test strategies that meet industry standards.

  

Responsibilities

  

DFT Strategy Development: Design and implement DFT methodologies for ASIC/SoC products, focusing on automotive/industrial/consumer applications to ensure high quality and reliability.

Architecture Design: Collaborate with hardware and software teams to integrate DFT features into the product architecture, ensuring compatibility with testing standards.

Team Leadership: Lead & manage a team of DFT engineers, providing mentorship and technical guidance to enhance their skills and capabilities.

Test Planning: Develop comprehensive test plans, including ATPG, BIST, and scan insertion strategies, to optimize fault coverage and reduce test costs.

Collaboration: Work closely with design, validation, test and manufacturing teams to align DFT strategies with overall product goals and requirements.

Quality Assurance: Establish metrics and benchmarks for DFT processes, and ensure compliance with automotive industry standards (e.g., ISO 26262).

Tool Development: Evaluate and implement DFT tools and methodologies to improve test efficiency and effectiveness.

Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with industry trends and technologies in DFT and automotive testing, driving innovation within the team.

  

Qualifications

  

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.

10 - 15+ years of experience in DFT for ASIC/SoC design, with a strong background in automotive applications.

Proven experience leading DFT teams and managing complex projects.

Experience in post silicon debug, yield improvement and On-field failure (EFAR) debug.

In-depth knowledge of DFT techniques such as scan design, boundary scan, BIST, and fault simulation.

Familiarity with automotive industry standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 26262).

Proficiency in using DFT tools and EDA software.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

  

About Us

  

**onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. description:
**Introduction:**  
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking an experienced Fluent Commerce OMS Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design,
  
implementation, and technical direction of enterprise-scale Order Management System (OMS) solutions using Fluent
  
Commerce.
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Fluent Commerce, distributed OMS architecture, retail and
  
eCommerce workflows, system integrations, and cloud-native architectures, along with strong experience
  
translating complex business requirements into scalable and resilient technical solutions.

technical leaders to define architecture and deliver high-performance OMS solutions supporting complex omnichannel
  
business models.
  
  
Solution Architecture & Technical Design
  
l Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Fluent Commerce OMS implementations.
  
l Design scalable, API-driven, event-based, and distributed OMS architectures.
  
l Define solution architecture, technical blueprints, and integration patterns aligned with retail and eCommerce best
  
practices.
  
l Translate complex business and functional requirements into robust technical architecture and detailed solution
  
designs.
  
l Define architecture principles, technology standards, design patterns, and technical best practices.
  
l Review and validate solution designs, configurations, custom extensions, APIs, and integration approaches.
  
l Ensure solutions meet required standards for performance, security, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  
l Identify technical risks, architectural gaps, and dependencies and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  
  
OMS & Fluent Commerce Architecture
  
l Provide technical leadership across the complete order lifecycle, including order capture, fulfillment, allocation,
  
orchestration, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, and inventory management.
  
l Design and architect Distributed Order Management (DOM) solutions for complex omnichannel business models.
  
l Define inventory orchestration and fulfillment strategies across multiple locations and channels.
  
l Architect Fluent Commerce extensions and configurations based on business and technical requirements.
  
l Ensure the OMS architecture supports scalability, flexibility, maintainability, and high availability.
  
  
Integration Architecture
  
l Define and oversee integration architecture between Fluent Commerce OMS and enterprise systems, including:
  
**l Payment gateways:** PayPal, Adyen, and Stripe
  
**l ERP platforms:** SAP and Oracle
  
l Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  
**l eCommerce platforms:** Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, and Magento
  
l CRM and loyalty platforms
  
l Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, asynchronous communication, and
  
event-driven architectures.
  
l Define reliable data flow and integration patterns between upstream and downstream systems.
  
l Review API contracts, integration specifications, data mappings, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  
l Ensure integrations are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Technical Governance & Quality
  
l Establish technical governance across OMS implementations.
  
l Conduct architecture reviews and design walkthroughs.
  
l Review technical deliverables and provide architectural guidance to development and integration teams.
  
l Define non-functional requirements and ensure they are incorporated into the solution design.
  
l Drive best practices around coding standards, integration design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production
  
readiness.
  
l Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
  
l Lead technical and solution architecture workshops with client stakeholders.
  
l Collaborate with business, functional, technical, and integration teams to understand requirements and define
  
appropriate solutions.
  
l Present architecture decisions, technical approaches, and solution recommendations to technical and non-technical
  
stakeholders.
  
l Act as the primary technical point of contact for architecture-related discussions.
  
l Provide technical guidance during implementation, production support, incident triage, and root cause analysis.
  
l Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, technical estimations, architecture proposals, and RFP
  
responses.
  
  
Required Skills & Experience
  
l 10+ years of overall IT experience with enterprise systems and large-scale digital platforms.
  
l 4+ years of hands-on experience with Fluent Commerce OMS.
  
l Strong expertise in Order Management Systems and Distributed Order Management (DOM).
  
l Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, including order orchestration, fulfillment, returns and
  
exchanges, cancellations and refunds, and inventory orchestration.
  
l Strong experience designing REST APIs, JSON-based integrations, webhooks, and
  
asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and distributed systems.
  
l Experience designing scalable, resilient, and high-availability solutions.
  
l Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  
l Strong understanding of Agile / Scrum delivery models.
  
l Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
l Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Preferred / Nice to Have
  
l Experience working in omnichannel retail and large-scale eCommerce environments.
  
l Experience with cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
  
l Experience integrating Fluent Commerce with SAP, Oracle, WMS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify,
  
Magento, CRM, and payment platforms.
  
l Prior experience in client-facing consulting or solution architecture roles.
  
l Experience designing and supporting high-availability production systems.
  
l Experience participating in pre-sales, RFPs, solution proposals, and technical estimations.
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and integration best practices.

title: R&D Solution Lead
description:

It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Job Summary**

You will be instrumental in solving complex technical challenges and ensuring the smooth functioning, scalability, security, and maintainability of R&D; technology solutions.

title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Overview**  

The Microsoft Security organization’s mission of making the world a safer place has never been more important. As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we drive improvements into our security products that keep our customers, applications, and devices safe. Security is one of the fastest growing, highly collaborative teams with an entrepreneurial mindset within Microsoft.

The Microsoft Defender family offers comprehensive threat prevention, detection, and response capabilities for everyone – from individuals looking to protect their family to the world’s largest enterprises. Linux servers run highly business-critical workloads for our customers and are increasingly targeted by attackers seeking to disrupt those workloads. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides a security solution to help protect Linux servers with high performance, quality, and innovative security capabilities. We are hiring a Group Engineering Manager for this product area. Our work provides peace of mind to customers by helping them protect their critical assets.

Our team includes people from a wide variety of backgrounds, previous work experiences, and life journeys, and we are eager to maintain and grow that diversity. We are passionate about learning on the job, collaborating with other teams, and staying deeply focused on customer needs. Join us to build easy-to-use cybersecurity products that positively impact over a billion users from all walks of life.

  
**Responsibilities**

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead, mentor, and grow a talented and diverse team of engineers focused on delivering products that create deep customer value. You will partner with other Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional leaders to build a sustainable, high-performing team and foster an engineering culture focused on delivering products our customers love.

You will collaborate across teams to develop innovative solutions that protect Linux servers through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and contribute to the growth of the business. You will provide strong technical and people leadership, establish engineering rigor, foster a data- and results-driven culture, and build an environment of collaboration, inclusion, and trust.

You will also help drive the adoption and impact of Microsoft Security products while enabling your team to deliver high-quality solutions at scale.

If you are passionate about **Linux, cybersecurity, engineering excellence, and building high-performing teams**, this role offers an exciting opportunity to bring those passions together.

 **Qualifications**  

* **12+ years of experience in software engineering**, with experience building enterprise software and a proven track record of shipping commercially successful software products and services.
* Demonstrated ability to **lead, mentor, nurture, and grow engineering talent**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams comprising Software Engineers, Program Managers, Security Researchers, and Data Scientists.
* **3+ years of experience leading and building engineering teams**.
* **7+ years of experience designing and developing applications and systems on Linux**.
* **7+ years of experience applying software development principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices**.
* Strong understanding of **Linux internals** and experience building Linux-based products.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with **secure software development lifecycle (SDL) practices**.
* Experience with software development tools and systems, including source control systems such as Git, automated build systems, compilers, software validation systems, project tracking tools, and lifecycle management systems.
* Ability to work independently and drive complex **technical and architectural decisions and dependencies**.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience building **Linux kernel modules**.
* Contributions to **Linux open-source projects**, particularly in the kernel space.

  
  
  

Software Engineering IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 - $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 - $219,200 per year.

description:

Job Description - Assistant Project Manger
  
**Job Title:** Assistant Project Manger - MEP
  
**Industry:** Industrial Construction / Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
  
Role Overview / Purpose
  
Seeking an experienced Assistant Project Manager MEP to lead the planning, design coordination, and execution of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for commercial building projects. This role serves as the technical authority for MEP systems integration, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Assistant Project Manager MEP will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including architects, structural engineers, contractors, and clients to deliver exceptional building performance.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Project Management & Execution
  
Lead MEP design coordination from concept through construction completion for commercial building projects ranging from office buildings to mixed-use developments
  
Develop comprehensive project schedules, critical path analyses, and milestone tracking for MEP work packages
  
Manage project budgets including cost estimation, value engineering proposals, and expenditure tracking to maintain financial targets
  
Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality, compliance with design specifications, and adherence to safety protocols
  
Commercial & Budget Management
  
Oversee project budgets, cost control, and financial performance for projects
  
Review and approve contractor claims, variations, and running account (RA) bills.
  
Monitor cost-to-completion forecasts and implement corrective measures for budget overruns.
  
Support commercial negotiations with contractors, vendors, and consultants.
  
Technical Coordination & Design Oversight
  
Review and coordinate MEP design documents, ensuring integration between mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems
  
Facilitate BIM coordination sessions to identify and resolve conflicts between MEP systems and architectural/structural elements
  
Evaluate mechanical system selections including HVAC equipment, controls, and distribution systems for optimal performance and efficiency
  
Oversee electrical load calculations, power distribution design, lighting systems, and emergency power provisions
  
Review plumbing layouts, domestic water systems, sanitary and storm drainage, and fire protection system designs
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Serve as primary MEP technical liaison with clients, addressing concerns and providing regular project updates
  
Manage relationships with MEP contractors, subcontractors, and vendors throughout design and construction phases
  
Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and other consultants to ensure seamless design integration
  
Facilitate submittal review processes, RFI responses, and change order evaluations
  
Quality Assurance & Compliance
  
Ensure all MEP systems comply with applicable building codes, safety regulations, and jurisdictional requirements
  
Implement quality control procedures including testing, commissioning oversight, and performance verification
  
Manage risk identification and mitigation strategies for MEP-related project challenges
  
Prepare comprehensive documentation including progress reports, technical memoranda, and lessons learned summaries
  
Required Qualifications
  
Education & Experience
  
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a reputed institution.
  
8 to 10 years of progressive experience in MEP project management within Industrial construction
  
Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering MEP systems for projects valued at $10M+
  
Technical Proficiency
  
Advanced knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and BIM 360 for design review and coordination
  
Proficiency with Navisworks or similar clash detection software
  
Experience with MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools
  
Familiarity with electrical load calculation software and hydraulic analysis tools
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
ASHRAE, NFPA, or IEEE membership demonstrating commitment to professional development
  
**Specialized experience in specific building types:** Class A office buildings, hospitality, healthcare facilities, or retail developments
  
Experience with commissioning processes and LEED certification projects
  
Previous mentorship or supervision of junior engineering staff
  
Technical Competencies
  
Mechanical Systems
  
HVAC system design principles including chilled water plants, boilers, air handling units, and variable refrigerant flow systems
  
Ventilation requirements, indoor air quality standards, and energy recovery systems
  
Building automation and controls integration
  
Electrical Systems
  
Power distribution from utility service through branch circuits
  
Emergency power systems, generators, and UPS configurations
  
Lighting design, photometric analysis, and advanced lighting controls
  
Fire alarm, security, and low-voltage systems coordination
  
Plumbing & Fire Protection
  
Domestic water, sanitary, and storm drainage system design
  
Sprinkler system hydraulics and fire pump requirements
  
Plumbing fixture sizing and water conservation strategies

description:

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

The role requires a strong combination of Salesforce functional analysis and hands-on functional testing experience. The Functional Analyst will work as the bridge between business stakeholders, Product Owners, Salesforce development teams and QA teams, translating business requirements into functional specifications and testable user stories while ensuring that delivered solutions meet defined business requirements and quality expectations.

The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of Salesforce, experience across the software development and testing lifecycle, and the ability to independently perform requirement analysis, test planning, functional/system testing, defect analysis, UAT support and release validation.

**Job Title:** MEP Engineer
  
**Industry:** Industrial Construction / Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
  
Role Overview / Purpose
  
Seeking an experienced MEP Engineer to lead the planning, design coordination, and execution of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for commercial building projects. This role serves as the technical authority for MEP systems integration, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Assistant Project Manager MEP will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including architects, structural engineers, contractors, and clients to deliver exceptional building performance.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Project Management & Execution
  
Lead MEP design coordination from concept through construction completion for commercial building projects ranging from office buildings to mixed-use developments
  
Develop comprehensive project schedules, critical path analyses, and milestone tracking for MEP work packages
  
Manage project budgets including cost estimation, value engineering proposals, and expenditure tracking to maintain financial targets
  
Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality, compliance with design specifications, and adherence to safety protocols
  
Commercial & Budget Management
  
Oversee project budgets, cost control, and financial performance for projects
  
Review and approve contractor claims, variations, and running account (RA) bills.
  
Monitor cost-to-completion forecasts and implement corrective measures for budget overruns.
  
Support commercial negotiations with contractors, vendors, and consultants.
  
Technical Coordination & Design Oversight
  
Review and coordinate MEP design documents, ensuring integration between mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems
  
Facilitate BIM coordination sessions to identify and resolve conflicts between MEP systems and architectural/structural elements
  
Evaluate mechanical system selections including HVAC equipment, controls, and distribution systems for optimal performance and efficiency
  
Oversee electrical load calculations, power distribution design, lighting systems, and emergency power provisions
  
Review plumbing layouts, domestic water systems, sanitary and storm drainage, and fire protection system designs
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Serve as primary MEP technical liaison with clients, addressing concerns and providing regular project updates
  
Manage relationships with MEP contractors, subcontractors, and vendors throughout design and construction phases
  
Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and other consultants to ensure seamless design integration
  
Facilitate submittal review processes, RFI responses, and change order evaluations
  
Quality Assurance & Compliance
  
Ensure all MEP systems comply with applicable building codes, safety regulations, and jurisdictional requirements
  
Implement quality control procedures including testing, commissioning oversight, and performance verification
  
Manage risk identification and mitigation strategies for MEP-related project challenges
  
Prepare comprehensive documentation including progress reports, technical memoranda, and lessons learned summaries
  
Required Qualifications
  
Education & Experience
  
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a reputed institution.
  
6 to 7 years of progressive experience in MEP project management within Industrial construction
  
Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering MEP systems for projects valued at $10M+
  
Technical Proficiency
  
Advanced knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and BIM 360 for design review and coordination
  
Proficiency with Navisworks or similar clash detection software
  
Experience with MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools
  
Familiarity with electrical load calculation software and hydraulic analysis tools
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
ASHRAE, NFPA, or IEEE membership demonstrating commitment to professional development
  
**Specialized experience in specific building types:** Class A office buildings, hospitality, healthcare facilities, or retail developments
  
Experience with commissioning processes and LEED certification projects
  
Previous mentorship or supervision of junior engineering staff
  
Technical Competencies
  
Mechanical Systems
  
HVAC system design principles including chilled water plants, boilers, air handling units, and variable refrigerant flow systems
  
Ventilation requirements, indoor air quality standards, and energy recovery systems
  
Building automation and controls integration
  
Electrical Systems
  
Power distribution from utility service through branch circuits
  
Emergency power systems, generators, and UPS configurations
  
Lighting design, photometric analysis, and advanced lighting controls
  
Fire alarm, security, and low-voltage systems coordination
  
Plumbing & Fire Protection
  
Domestic water, sanitary, and storm drainage system design
  
Sprinkler system hydraulics and fire pump requirements
  
Plumbing fixture sizing and water conservation strategies

* Prepare and verify Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for civil, structural, and finishing works.
* Calculate quantities of materials, labour, equipment, and other project resources.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead a healthy, capable and outcome-owned engineering group that delivers X3 readiness while protecting quality, customer continuity, people development and sustainable delivery capacity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Experience leading software engineering teams delivering commercial, cloud or ERP products.
  
- Technical fluency across modern backend engineering, SQL/databases, APIs, legacy modernisation, SaaS delivery and automation.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to manage distributed teams, dependencies, hiring, performance, development and difficult conversations.
  
- Comfort with delivery metrics, quality gates, reliability, support economics and evidence-based governance.
  
- Strong English communication and the judgement to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Use developer and operator feedback, platform adoption, delivery flow, reliability, support effort and cost to guide capacity and improvement. Be fluent in secure delivery, identity, telemetry, lifecycle and rollback decisions for the group; implementation depth and tool use remain with the relevant engineers.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience scaling India engineering capacity in a global product organisation.
  
- Hands-on exposure to L4G/4GL, Progress 4GL, Web/Syracuse, data migration or batch processing.
  
- Sage X3/Xtrem and enterprise application language experience.
  
- Cloud platform, migration programmes, partner ecosystems or regulated SaaS.
  
- Formal people leadership qualification or Agile coaching experience.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 10+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing or leading engineering teams. Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Squads have named owners, realistic capacity, clear dependencies and a visible path to each evidence gate.
  
- Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
  
- India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
  
- Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.
  
\*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities \*\*become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.\*
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, People teams, Programme Management, Security, Cloud Support/L3, Customer Services, partners and senior leadership across regions. Maintains practical Europe/North America overlap for decisions and escalation.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own delivery capacity, staffing, prioritisation flow, quality, dependencies, risk and continuity for one or more multidisciplinary squads.
  
- Create the conditions for engineers, automation specialists, product and architecture partners to deliver measurable outcomes rather than activity.
  
- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.
  
- Run transparent delivery and risk reviews; ensure quarterly evidence gates, monthly scorecards and scope guardrails are respected.
  
- Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.
  
- Ensure incident learning, support knowledge transfer, security, inclusion and psychological safety are part of normal delivery.
  
Decision ownership:
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Principal Engineer – Design Engineering
description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

**Job Description:**

Microchip’s Communications Business Unit (CBU) develops high-performance networking, connectivity, and edge compute semiconductor solutions that power communications infrastructure, data centers, automotive systems, aerospace and defense platforms, and industrial applications. Our global team works across the full product lifecycle to deliver innovative products that enable the world’s most demanding connected systems.

The CBU Product Development team is engaged through the full device R&D cycle from concept, design and implementation stages. Once a prototype is available, we support embedded software development and system validation lab testing through to mass-market production release. We are an experienced chip team working with the latest semiconductor development tools and methodologies in advanced process technologies to develop state-of-the-art network devices.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer in the CBU Product Development team who will be responsible for the design and implementation of digital integrated circuits at the block or top level of a device, solve challenging engineering problems with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with chip architects, subsystem leads and verification team members to deliver increasingly complex designs in a friendly and professional environment.

Responsibilities may include:

* Contribute to the microarchitecture of communication semiconductor devices in partnership with team leads, mentors and device architects
* Design digital circuits based on leading-edge industry standards and market requirements
* Implement designs in System Verilog RTL code utilizing low-power design principles
* Synthesize designs into logic gates taking advantage of industry-leading tools and flows
* Provide floor-planning guidance and support to physical design/layout teams
* Integrate digital and analog circuits with Design-for-Test (DFT) techniques
* Verify physical timing specifications through Static Timing Analysis (STA)
* Support of products from Specification through to Production in collaboration with Engineers in Physical Design, Validation, Applications, Software/Firmware, Product Marketing and Production Engineering
* Develop areas of technical expertise to contribute to the wider team beyond individual deliverables or responsibilities

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
* 8+ years related experience
* Excellent analytical and debugging skills and the ability to proactively solve issues
* Proven ability to thrive on, learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies
* Coding expertise in one or more of SystemVerilog/Verilog or VHDL.
* Experience using one or more of Tcl/Perl/Python, C/C++, XML
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Experience with Lint, CDC, formal verification, logic synthesis, and static timing analysis.
* Understanding of physical design interactions, including timing, power, and congestion considerations.
* Knowledge of DFT, including scan, testability considerations, and DFT sign-off interactions.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, and/or Awk.
* Experience with Synopsys or Cadence tool flows for synthesis, verification or STA (an asset)
* Experience with 28nm and smaller silicon process technologies (an asset)

**Travel Time:**

0% - 25%

**To all recruitment agencies**: *Microchip Technology Inc.* ***does not*** *accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

title: Software Development Engineer 5
description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.

Is this role for you?

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus):**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery:**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity:**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision:**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

**Role Summary**

The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.

* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.

* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.

* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.

* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.

* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.

* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.

* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.

* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.

* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).

* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.

* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.

* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.

* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.

* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.

* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.

* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.

* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

**Essential Skills**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale.

* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.

* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.

* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling.

* Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths.

* Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments.

* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.

* Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores.

* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.

* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.

* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).

* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.

* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.

* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).

* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets.

* Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion.

* Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them.

* Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards.

* Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience.
